jobs.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

What you'll do

Let's get the tricky part out of the way: this role doesn't fit neatly into a box. It's part legal tech specialist, part product expert, part solutions architect, and part trusted advisor. If you want a role that stays static, this isn't it.

Your mission is to help some of the world's leading law firms get the absolute most out of Legora. You'll understand how lawyers work, how firms operate, and where AI can make the biggest difference — then turn that potential into workflows that deliver real value.

You'll be the person clients call when they want to rethink how legal work gets done — whether that's transforming how a practice group delivers work, embedding Legora across an international firm, or helping partners build the case for AI adoption.

Specifically, you will

  • Act as a genuine thought partner to law firms — understanding their practice areas, commercial priorities and ways of working, then identifying high-value opportunities to transform how legal services are delivered.

  • Own the journey alongside Customer Success from early pilots through onboarding to firm-wide adoption, turning initial use cases into sustained, measurable impact across teams, offices and practice groups.

  • Design and implement workflows around the realities of private practice — from due diligence, contract review and drafting to litigation, regulatory advisory, transactions and knowledge management.

  • Partner with law firm partners, innovation leaders, knowledge teams and practising lawyers to build the case for AI adoption, connecting Legora's capabilities to outcomes that matter to the firm and its clients.

  • Be the voice of the private practice lawyer inside Legora — bringing a deep understanding of legal workflows, client expectations and the commercial realities of law firms into product development, roadmap priorities and strategic direction.

  • Deliver clear, confident product demos, workshops and training that make the potential of Legora tangible for everyone from associates and partners to firm leadership.

  • Help firms navigate one of the most significant shifts in legal service delivery — moving beyond individual productivity gains towards fundamental changes in how legal work is performed, priced and delivered to clients.

  • Document what works, build scalable playbooks and help shape how Legora partners with leading law firms as we grow globally.

What you'll bring

You've worked in private practice and understand the reality of delivering legal advice in a law firm. You know that great legal work isn't just about getting the right answer — it's about delivering exceptional quality under pressure, managing demanding clients, exercising sound judgement and balancing commercial expectations with the highest professional standards.

But you've also never been entirely satisfied with how legal work has always been done. You're curious about technology, drawn to better ways of working, and excited by the opportunity to fundamentally change how law firms operate and deliver value to their clients.

We're looking for

  • Meaningful experience working within a law firm, giving you a strong understanding of private practice, legal workflows, client expectations and the commercial pressures of delivering legal services.

  • Strong legal judgement and credibility. A legal qualification is valuable, but we're ultimately interested in your ability to understand sophisticated legal work and how it can be transformed.

  • Tech-curious and product-savvy — not necessarily a coder, but someone who leans into technical conversations around generative AI, implementation and workflow transformation.

  • Commercially minded — you understand how law firms operate and can connect changes in legal workflows to outcomes that matter to partners, practice groups and their clients.

  • A natural translator — comfortable moving between practising lawyers, partners, innovation and knowledge teams, product teams and engineers.

  • Someone who brings structure to ambiguity and energy to complexity — the calm, credible presence clients rely on when they're navigating significant change.

  • Proactive and self-directed, with the ability to manage multiple complex client relationships without losing quality or pace.

  • High standards without perfectionism — you ship, you learn, and you make it better over time.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

How success is measured

This is a role for someone starting out in sales. We're looking for around one to two years' experience in an office environment, in any field, so this could be your first move into a sales career. You'll learn the market, the product and the sales cycle with close support from the team, and take on more ownership as you go.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems. We've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

Our culture:

Never settle – We think of ourselves as ‘embedded hero-makers’ for our customers. We put them first, and if we say we’ll do something, we’ll move heaven and earth to do it. We think boldly and embrace change.

Take ownership - We think rigorously and deeply about a problem, but then charge at it, acting with and urgency and speed that sets us apart. But we never lose sight of quality or long-term scalability.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Our engineering ways of working:

  • Our Product and Engineering organisation is structured into four tribes: Custody, Accounts, Experience, and Cloud & Security. Each tribe contains multiple autonomous squads, with clear full ownership over specific product domains.

  • The squads are intentionally small and cross-functional, typically made up of an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and 3–5 engineers with complementary skills aligned to the domain they own.

  • We operate in a build-and-run model, with teams responsible for the full software lifecycle, from architecture and delivery through to operational support and incident management.

  • Our core platform is built on AWS serverless technologies including Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, S3, and ECS. As an engineer at Seccl you will design, build and operate reliable and scalable, testable and maintainable software solutions, building new functionalities and products using Typescript and Node.js. You play a key role in our software development and have a hands-on approach throughout the development process supporting resilient financial workflow systems and regulated investment operations.   • Have a strong ability to understand business and customer problems and turn them into efficient, scalable solutions. Be curious about how investment and custody products operate, and pragmatic in balancing customer value, operational correctness, engineering quality and long-term scalability.

  • Experience building financial systems with multi-region, multi-currency or trading-related complexity would be advantageous.

jobs.title: (Senior) Economist für Energiemärkte (w/m/d) bei Dezernat Zukunft – Institut für Makrofinanzen
jobs.description:
Wer wir sind und was wir suchen

Ob die Energiewende gelingt, entscheidet sich nicht allein an Technologien, sondern an Kosten, Märkten und politischen Weichenstellungen. Genau dazu arbeitet das Energy Lab des Dezernat Zukunft – und um unsere Arbeit weiter zu vertiefen, suchen wir Dich. 

Das Dezernat Zukunft ist ein überparteilicher Berliner Think Tank an der Schnittstelle von Politik, Verwaltung und Forschung. Rund 30 Personen verfolgen gemeinsam das Ziel, Geld-, Finanz- und Wirtschaftspolitik neu zu denken und verständlich zu vermitteln. Geleitet von den Werten Würde, Wohlstand, Demokratie und Nachhaltigkeit suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – idealerweise ab dem 1. Januar – für unser Energy Lab eine Person als (Senior) Economist für Energiemärkte. 

In dieser Position konzipierst Du Analysen und Studien zu Energiemärkten – insbesondere zum Strommarkt – und führst sie eigenständig durch. Dabei betrachtest Du Energiekosten, Investitionsbedarfe, Gesamtsystemkosten sowie die Wechselwirkungen politischer Instrumente mit diesen Größen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Fragen, wie sich Energiepolitik mit Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, Nachhaltigkeit und Bezahlbarkeit zusammendenken lässt, wie Energiekosten strategisch und gezielt gesenkt werden können, und wie das regulatorische Umfeld so ausgestaltet werden kann, dass es den Erfolg der „zweiten Hälfte der Energiewende“ und damit die Erreichung der Klimaneutralität ermöglicht.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst Energiemärkte und -preise, einschließlich Systemkosten, und koordinierst dazu Forschungsprojekte. Dabei betrachtest Du auch fiskalpolitische Auswirkungen sowie Wechselwirkungen mit dem Stromnetzausbau. 
  • Du entwickelst konkrete Politikvorschläge, Analysen und Positionen zu den oben genannten Themen, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Kolleg:innen im Energy Lab des Dezernat Zukunft sowie den weiteren Teams der Organisation. Außerdem organisierst Du Expert:innen-Gespräche und andere inhaltliche Veranstaltungen. 
  • Du interagierst aktiv mit Vertreter:innen von Parlamenten, Regierungen, Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft und Medien. Unsere Arbeit funktioniert nur dann, wenn wir mit diesen Gruppen im Austausch stehen, zuhören und zusammenarbeiten.


Das bieten wir

  • Eine Vergütung in Anlehnung an den Tarifvertrag des öffentlichen Dienstes (TVöD): Eingruppierung in Entgeltgruppe E 13 – abhängig von Deiner Erfahrung – inkl. Jahressonderzahlung und 30 Urlaubstagen.
  • Aktive Unterstützung bei Deiner Weiterentwicklung – fachlich sowie in Bezug auf Kompetenzen, Netzwerke und Aufgaben. 
  • Einen Arbeitsplatz in Berlin-Mitte mit der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten und gemeinsam vereinbarten Kernzeiten.
  • Unbürokratische, verständnisvolle Regelungen bei kurzfristigen Care-Bedarfen; bezahlte Freistellung nach § 29 TVöD bei persönlichen Anlässen (z. B. kranke Kinder). 
  • Einen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket oder JobRad. 
  • Und nicht zuletzt: Ein dynamisches,motiviertes Team, gemeinsame Events (z. B. Berg- oder Paddel-Ausflüge) und Arbeit, die zählt. 


Dein Profil

  • Du teilst unsere Werte und Ziele, begeisterst Dich für Energie- und Klimapolitik und brennst dafür, dass die Transformation gelingt. 
  • Du hast einen Master-Abschluss in einem relevanten Fachgebiet sowie mindestens zwei Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung. Du kennst Dich in Energiemärkten – insbesondere im Strommarkt – aus, verstehst politische Instrumente und erkennst, welche Zahlen für politische Entscheidungen und ökonomische Weichenstellungen wirklich zählen. 
  • Du konzipierst und erstellst eigene Analysen – quantitativ wie textlich – selbstständig und gründlich. Du hast bereits erfolgreich Forschungsprojekte umgesetzt und Ergebnisse sowie politische Handlungsempfehlungen prägnant kommuniziert. Du bist Dir bewusst, dass unsere Analysen und Vorschläge in der Öffentlichkeit intensiv geprüft werden, und arbeitest entsprechend gewissenhaft und bist bereit, als Eigentümer:in für Deine Projekte einzustehen.
  • Du kommunizierst sehr gut in deutscher und englischer Sprache und verfasst in beiden Sprachen anspruchsvolle, gut verständliche Texte.
  • Du hast fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in der praktischen Anwendung gängiger KI-Programme. 
  • Du willst den Dingen auf den Grund gehen und jeden Tag dazulernen. Noch wichtiger als mitgebrachtes Wissen ist für uns die Fähigkeit, es zu erweitern und Meinungen zu ändern. 
  • Du arbeitest gern im Team, hörst zu und unterstützt und förderst Deine Kolleg:innen.
Die perfekte Kandidat:in erfüllt nicht immer jede Anforderung. Wenn Du glaubst, dass Du zu uns passt – bewirb Dich gern trotzdem und sag uns, warum.


Beschäftigungsbeginn & Vertragsbedingungen

  • Beginn: Von uns aus so schnell wie möglich. Im Anschluss an das Bewerbungsverfahren rechnen wir mit einem Start im Januar 2027. Das genaue Startdatum ist verhandelbar. 
  • Umfang: 32–39 Stunden/Woche (flexibel je nach Deiner Verfügbarkeit). 
  • Befristung: zunächst 1 Jahr (Entfristung nach zwei Jahren angestrebt).


Bewerbungsverfahren

Bitte bewirb Dich online mit Lebenslauf und einem kurzen Anschreiben, das Deine Eignung entlang der oben genannten Kriterien zeigt. Bitte teile uns auch mit, wie Du auf die Stelle aufmerksam geworden bist und welche Wochenarbeitszeit Du bevorzugen würdest. 

Bewerbungsfrist: 08. November 2026

Das Bewerbungsverfahren besteht aus drei Runden: im ersten Schritt einem Assessment-Test, der aus einer schriftlichen Aufgabe besteht und ca. 1-2 Stunden Arbeitszeit beansprucht; anschließend ein längeres Gespräch bei uns vor Ort im Büro und einem abschließenden Gespräch mit unserem Head of Energy Lab – Janek Steitz.

Wir schätzen Vielfalt und möchten die Diversität unseres Teams fördern. Bewerbungen sind willkommen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, kultureller oder sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.


Kontakt / Rückfragen

jobs.title: Senior Compliance Manager – Quality & Regulatory Affairs / QMB ISO 13485 (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Intro

Back problems are the most common reason for inability to work in Germany.

Vivira has the solution: digital exercise therapy via app – always available, simple, effective, and reimbursed by health insurance. Behind every application permanently listed in the DiGA directory stands a robust quality management system. That is exactly why we are looking for you: As Senior Compliance Manager, you will take on the role of Quality Management Representative (QMB) according to ISO 13485 and keep our medical devices MDR-compliant – from the next audit to the inclusion of further products in the DiGA directory.


Your responsibilities include

As Senior Compliance Manager (m/f/d), you will be responsible for our quality management system and take on the role of Quality Management Representative according to ISO 13485. You report directly to our Team Lead Compliance and work closely with Engineering and Product.

  • QMS & Regulatory Affairs: You monitor compliance with DiGAV, MDR, ISO 13485, and ISO 27001, contribute to our BSI certification topics, and develop processes, SOPs, and Work Instructions pragmatically and based on risk.

  • Technical Documentation: You create and maintain the Technical Documentation according to MDR (DHF/DMR) for our three medical devices – one app listed in the DiGA directory and two CE-marked products in DiGA studies.

  • Audits: You prepare and follow up on external audits with the notified body, and plan and conduct internal audits. Your first milestone: the ISO 13485 recertification audit in February 2027 – with a stable system, complete documentation, and a planned handover by your predecessor.

  • Releases & Post-Market Surveillance: You review and approve release documentation and are responsible for post-market surveillance of our products.

  • Supplier Management: You evaluate and monitor our software providers (e.g. Atlassian, HubSpot, Google) according to criticality.

  • Regulatory Radar: You evaluate regulatory changes monthly and derive concrete measures.

  • Interface within the Company: You are the primary contact for regulatory questions across all departments – from Doctor Success to Patient Success –, train colleagues, and proactively gather input.

Whether the role of PRRC (Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance) becomes part of the function will be discussed together during the selection process – depending on your qualification and a clear agreement on responsibilities.

Opportunity

Hybrid (2 days on-site per week) · Permanent, full-time

About the role
You'll take ownership of Agile delivery effectiveness across one or more defence software Squads, working at the intersection of Product, Engineering and business stakeholders to turn complex priorities into predictable, sustainable delivery.

This is a permanent role in a Spotify-inspired organisation (Squads, Chapters, Tribes), where Senior Scrum Masters contribute not only to team success, but also to the continuous improvement of delivery practices across the wider organisation.

You'll operate in a multi-Squad environment with dependencies spanning engineering, product, documentation and customer-facing teams. The role extends beyond a single Squad and requires the ability to influence outcomes across organisational boundaries.


Your Mission

What you'll do

  • Create the conditions for effective delivery, ensuring Agile events, stakeholder interactions and team collaboration help Squads make informed decisions, maintain momentum and deliver valuable outcomes.
  • Coach Squads, Product stakeholders and leadership, helping them apply Agile thinking pragmatically rather than mechanically.
  • Identify, manage and remove impediments, risks and dependencies that impact delivery performance.
  • Partner with Market Product Managers to strengthen backlog refinement, sprint readiness and roadmap execution, while ensuring priorities, dependencies and delivery constraints remain visible.
  • Collaborate with Tech Writers to ensure documentation activities are planned and aligned with delivery objectives.
  • Use delivery insights and Agile metrics to improve predictability, transparency and sustainable ways of working.
  • Coordinate with Scrum Masters, Chapters and stakeholders to resolve cross-team dependencies and systemic delivery challenges.
  • Mentor less experienced Scrum Masters and contribute to the continuous improvement of Agile practices across ILIAS.

What success looks like
Your Squads deliver valuable outcomes predictably and sustainably, while collaboration across teams continues to improve. Product, Engineering and business stakeholders understand priorities, risks and dependencies early enough to act on them rather than react to them.

Teams take ownership of their commitments and continuously improve how they work, using Agile practices as tools for delivery rather than goals in themselves.

Stakeholders trust delivery forecasts because expectations are clear, communication is transparent and progress is visible.
What you bring
  • 5+ years working in Agile software delivery environments, with substantial experience as a Scrum Master or a comparable Agile delivery or coaching role.
  • Strong practical understanding of Scrum, Agile and Lean principles.
  • Experience coaching teams and stakeholders to improve collaboration, delivery effectiveness and ways of working.
  • Proven ability to facilitate complex discussions, resolve impediments and navigate competing priorities.
  • Experience influencing delivery across multiple teams, programmes or organisational domains, balancing team autonomy with broader business objectives.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve organisational delivery effectiveness, not only team-level performance.
  • Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Professional working proficiency in English.

  • PSM II, PSM III, A-CSM, CSP-SM, SAFe Scrum Master or a comparable certification.
  • Experience working in a Spotify-inspired organisation with Squads, Chapters and Tribes.
  • Experience supporting multiple Agile teams within a complex software environment.
  • Familiarity with Agile reporting, delivery forecasting and continuous improvement practices.
  • Experience with Jira or similar Agile delivery tools.
  • Previous mentoring or coaching experience.

ILIAS Solutions develops software that helps defence organisations maintain operational readiness. The software supports maintenance, logistics and operational readiness in environments where reliability, coordination and long-term product quality matter.

As a Senior Scrum Master, you'll work closely with Market Product Managers, engineers, Tech Writers and leadership teams to support the delivery of mission-critical software used by defence organisations worldwide.

ILIAS Solutions is part of the Patria Group.

Deine Aufgaben

Deine Kernaufgaben sind:

  • Strategische Projekte leiten: Du leitest eigenverantwortlich bereichsübergreifende Veränderungs-, Effizienz- und Prozessoptimierungsprojekte sowie Software- und Digitalisierungsprojekte.

  • Energiewirtschaftliche Projekte voranbringen: Du arbeitest dich in die relevanten Zusammenhänge im Umfeld von Energiehandel, Direktvermarktung und digitalen Lösungen ein, stellst die richtigen Fragen und führst fachliche, technische und operative Anforderungen zu belastbaren Lösungen und konkreten Projektergebnissen zusammen.
  • End-to-End-Prozesse verbessern: Du analysierst Abläufe, erkennst Brüche und Verbesserungspotenziale und gestaltest wirksame, effiziente Prozesse mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten und pragmatischen Lösungen.
  • Budgetcontrolling: Du prüfst projektbezogene Stunden und Kosten, koordinierst die Rechnungsfreigabe und behältst das Projektbudget im Blick.

Darüber hinaus gestaltest du unser Projektmanagement weiter:

  • Verbesserungen wirklich umsetzen: Du treibst die gemeinsam identifizierten und beschlossenen Effizienz- und Prozessverbesserungen voran und überprüfst, ob die angestrebte Wirkung im Alltag eintritt.
  • Projektmanagement weiterentwickeln: Du entwickelst Methoden, Frameworks und Best-Practices weiter, besonders für agile Softwareentwicklungsprojekte, und stärkst damit Qualität, Tempo und Ergebnisorientierung.
  • Projektarbeit bereichsübergreifend verankern: Du bindest die relevanten Fachbereiche ein, integrierst die Projektarbeit in den laufenden Geschäftsbetrieb und sorgst für klare Verantwortlichkeiten, verbindliche Entscheidungen und sichtbare Fortschritte. In einer Organisation mit dezentralen Zuständigkeiten entwickelst du unsere Projektmanagement-Strukturen, Rollen und Standards pragmatisch weiter.


Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Leitung komplexer Projekte, idealerweise in Veränderungsprojekten, Prozessoptimierung, Digitalisierung oder Softwareentwicklung.
  • Fundierte Praxis im klassischen Projektmanagement, zum Beispiel in Planung und Steuerung von Umfang, Terminen, Ressourcen, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten.
  • Vor allem bringst du praktische Erfahrung im agilen Projektmanagement von Softwareentwicklungsprojekten mit und hast idealerweise bereits KI-gestützte Werkzeuge oder Methoden im Projektkontext eingesetzt.
  • Erfahrung darin, fachliche Anforderungen mit technischen Teams zu klären und aus komplexen Fragestellungen umsetzbare Arbeitspakete und Entscheidungen zu machen.
  • Klare Kommunikation, analytisches und strukturiertes Denken sowie die Fähigkeit, auch bei unterschiedlichen Perspektiven und Prioritäten Orientierung zu schaffen.
  • Sicherheit in der Moderation von Workshops und in der lateralen Führung interdisziplinärer Teams.
  • Interesse daran, Projektmanagement-Strukturen, Rollen und Standards weiterzuentwickeln. Du bringst Eigeninitiative, Pragmatismus und den Anspruch mit, Konzepte nicht nur zu entwickeln, sondern Ergebnisse gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten in die Praxis zu bringen.
  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Entscheidend ist für uns vor allem deine relevante Projekterfahrung.
  • Erfahrung in der Modellierung und Dokumentation von Geschäftsprozessen mit BPMN sowie deren Anwendung im Projektmanagement. 
  • Energiewirtschaftliche Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Hilfreich sind Kenntnisse zu erneuerbaren Energien, Direktvermarktung, Stromhandel, Bilanzkreismanagement, PPAs oder virtuellen Kraftwerken. Du solltest jedoch bereit und in der Lage sein, dich zügig in energiewirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge einzuarbeiten, fachliche Anforderungen zu verstehen und gemeinsam mit den Teams in tragfähige Lösungen und umsetzbare Arbeitspakete zu übersetzen.
  • Deutsch C2 (GER) in Wort und Schrift ist erforderlich, um die Kommunikation mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen zu ermöglichen.


Warum wir?

Als wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich erneuerbare Energien und Energiehandel mit Start-up-Atmosphäre bieten wir dir nicht nur ein vielseitiges Aufgabenfeld, sondern auch echten Gestaltungsspielraum, Verantwortung und die Möglichkeit, aktiv an der Energiewende mitzuwirken.

jobs.title: Senior FX Sales Executive
jobs.description:
About the role

Are you passionate about opening doors, winning new business, and building relationships with leading financial institutions?

As a Senior FX Sales Executive, you'll play a key role in expanding DIGITEC's presence, with a strong focus on acquiring new clients and developing strategic business opportunities within the FX market.

We're looking for a proactive, commercially driven sales professional who thrives on identifying opportunities, building a pipeline from the ground up, and turning prospects into long-term clients.

You'll take ownership of the full sales cycle, from prospecting and initial engagement to commercial negotiations and closing deals. Working closely with our global Sales, Product, and Client Services teams, you'll introduce DIGITEC's innovative FX solutions to banks and financial institutions.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys the challenge of winning new business, values autonomy, and wants to make a direct impact on our international growth.

The position is based in our London office, with hybrid working (2 days a week in the office).


Your Responsibilities

  • Identify, develop, and win new business opportunities with banks and financial institutions, with a strong focus on new logo acquisition.
  • Build and manage a robust sales pipeline through proactive prospecting, networking, and strategic outreach.
  • Own the full sales cycle, from initial contact and discovery meetings to product demonstrations, negotiations, and contract signing.
  • Establish relationships with senior decision-makers across FX Trading, Treasury, Technology, and other relevant business areas.
  • Identify market opportunities and develop effective strategies to expand DIGITEC's presence.
  • Deliver compelling product presentations and demonstrations, translating complex FX technology into clear business value.
  • Collaborate closely with global Sales, Product, and Client Services teams to develop tailored solutions and ensure a smooth transition from sales to implementation.
  • Represent DIGITEC at client meetings, industry conferences, and networking events to strengthen our visibility within the FX community.
  • Provide market insights, competitive intelligence, and client feedback to support our commercial and product strategies.
  • Travel internationally as needed to meet prospective clients, attend industry events, and collaborate with international colleagues.


Preferred qualifications

  • Several years of experience in B2B sales, new business development, or enterprise software sales, ideally within financial services or financial technology.
  • A proven track record of acquiring new clients and closing new business, rather than primarily managing existing accounts.
  • Experience within FX, Capital Markets, FICC, Treasury, electronic trading, fintech, or financial software.
  • Strong understanding of financial markets and key stakeholders.
  • Experience managing complex, consultative sales cycles involving multiple decision-makers.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently build and develop a sales pipeline, from prospect identification through deal closure.
  • A proactive, entrepreneurial, and results-driven mindset, with a strong motivation to open new doors and win business.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with confidence in engaging senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with international teams.
  • Fluency in English is required.
Nice-to-have
Experience with one or more of the following would be an advantage: 
  • An established professional network within banks, financial institutions, or the FX trading community.
  • FX Swaps, NDFs, Money Markets, or electronic trading.
  • FX trading platforms, order management systems, or banking technology.
  • Enterprise SaaS or complex financial software sales.
  • CRM systems such as HubSpot or Salesforce.


What we offer as an employer

  • Join an Innovative Leader: Be part of a pioneering SaaS tech company recognised as the global standard in its category, experiencing impressive double-digit annual growth.
  • Transform a Major Market: Contribute to our mission of revolutionising the FX Swaps market with cutting-edge solutions and technologies.
  • Be part of an international workforce: Work within a truly multi-national team, collaborating with colleagues from across the globe, located in London, Hamburg, and Singapore.
  • Make an Impact: Hone your skills in small teams where your ideas matter, actively shaping your role and driving your personal growth.
  • Enjoy Competitive Benefits: Benefit from a competitive compensation and benefits package, including 30 days of annual paid leave.
  • Invest in Your Development: Access a €1,000 (or equivalent in local currency) yearly budget dedicated to further education and professional development.


Our commitment to inclusion:

We welcome applications from people of all ages, backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, gender identities, religions and sexual orientations, as well as from disabled and neurodivergent people and people living with chronic conditions.

Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about what you can bring than about a perfect match.

If anything in our application or interview process could be more accessible for you, just let us know. You don’t need to tell us why, and it won’t affect your application.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant, Tracking Strategy & Insights
jobs.description:
Introduction:

As a Senior Consultant on our newly formed Tracking Strategy & Insights (TS&I) team, you will act as the key strategic partner accountable for the successful integration and value realization of our clients’ tracking programs. You will blend deep marketing research expertise (informed by the Ehrenberg-Bass Institute school of thought) with exceptional storytelling skills to convert tracking technology insights into actionable business strategy.

Are you curious and want to shoot for the stars, open to giving and receiving feedback, hungry for empowerment and always taking a hands-on approach? Well then we want to chat. quantilope automates consumer research to unlock high quality insights with speed & ease. We're a fast growing organization looking for the right people to join our team.


What you will be doing:

  • Strategic Program Management: Serve as the trusted advisor and lead partner for complex, multi-category, or multi-country tracking programs, maintaining continuous, high-level engagement with key client stakeholders and executives.
  • Research Scoping: Lead discovery sessions to understand and define program needs, scope, objectives, and hypotheses. Translate core objectives into research inputs aligned with quantilope's methodology, setting customers up for long-term success.

You'll own a real book of business in Russian speaker markets. There is a sales and account-management motion. The size of the responsibility comes from top-line ownership. Quota chasing is not the job. You shape the work and execute it.

About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

The Role

Docker Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) embed directly with our most strategic customers to solve important, complex technical problems and turn ambitious ideas into production outcomes. FDEs take on the most challenging technical challenges using existing Docker products and patterns when possible, and work across customer, Docker Product and Engineering teams to realize new approaches when required.

 

As a Docker FDE, you will work side-by-side with customer engineering teams to deeply understand their goals, problems, constraints, and technical landscape; identify the highest-leverage opportunities; and design, build, and ship solutions with them. You own the technical journey from discovery and architecture through prototyping, implementation and production rollout.

 

The solutions you build may use existing Docker products, extend Docker into new environments, integrate deeply with customer and third-party systems, or reveal capabilities that Docker should build next. You work closely with Docker Solutions Architects to evolve existing patterns, and Docker Product and Engineering to turn new learnings into reusable patterns and product capabilities.

_______________________________________________________________________

 

Responsibilities

Build in Production with Customers

  • Embed with customer engineering teams to design, build, and ship solutions from first prototype through stable production rollout. Use existing Docker products and patterns when possible, invent, prototype and validate innovative solutions when necessary.

  • Deliver working technical artifacts to customers: custom MCP servers with tightly integrated Docker Sandbox environments for coding agents and containerized agents; Docker Compose definitions for multi-agent harnesses and model-backed applications; Hardened Image standardization and migration; New tools that unblock customer progress.

  • Integrate Docker's AI platform with the customer's existing stack, including identity providers (OIDC/SAML/SSO), secrets management, private and air-gapped registries, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.

  • Own technical delivery on your engagements: scope the work, sequence it, make trade-offs between speed and quality, remove blockers early, and contribute directly to code whenever progress depends on it.

Make AI Adoption Safe and Governable

  • Translate customer security, compliance, and platform requirements into concrete plans and see those plans through from ideation to production.

  • Help customers define controls to enable them to adopt agentic AI to solve their unique business problems without compromising security, compliance, data sovereignty or end-user experience.

  • Establish quality and performance standards for customers and work closely with Docker Product and Engineering to quickly address issues that fall outside of established thresholds

  • Partner with customer security and platform teams to get agentic workloads through architecture review, threat modeling, and change control.

Partner with Solutions Architecture and the Field

  • Work closely with Solutions Architects to enable off-the-self solutions when possible and provide technical experience and leadership when a bespoke solution is necessary.

  • Feed implementation learnings back into reference architectures, SOW templates, and success patterns so that FDE innovations become standard features and implementation patterns.

  • Support the field with technical depth during proofs of concept, escalations, and expansion conversations when a working build is the fastest path to a customer adoption.

Close the Loop with Product and Engineering

  • As part of Docker Engineering FDEs work closely with Product and Engineering teams to fold FDE innovations, learnings, and design patterns into existing or new products and services.

  • Work with Customers, Product and Engineering to establish quality and performance thresholds, ensuring customer environments meet them consistently, and responding quickly and decisively when they don’t.

  • Be the voice of the customer. Deliver data-driven and actionable feedback to Product and Engineering: what works well; what does not; what customers are asking for; and what blocks their adoption and forward progress. FDE experience directly influences the roadmap.

Shape the Practice

  • Define the FDE engagement model, delivery standards, and quality bar, and codify them so that engagements are consistent across customers, regions, and delivery partners.

  • Mentor and lead other Forward Deployed Engineers, and participate in hiring loops to grow the team.

  • Act as the senior technical escalation point on the hardest problems impacting your customers. Every incident is an opportunity to improve Docker products and services.

  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of the agentic AI stack: LLMs, APIs, MCP, coding agents, model and harness evaluation approaches, performance and quality thresholds, deployment patterns.

  • This role may require participation in an on-call rotation to provide support outside of standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

_______________________________________________________________________

 

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Professional Services Engineer, or Software Engineer with consulting or technical founder experience.

  • Technical leadership across multiple engagements, teams, or domains, with a proven ability to set delivery standards, define repeatable patterns, and influence product direction through field evidence.

  • Expert production coding skills in Go, Python, or TypeScript, with a track record of shipping and operating software that other people depend on and of leading technical design reviews.

  • Deep, hands-on Docker expertise: Dockerfiles and multi-stage builds, Docker Compose, image and registry operations, container networking and storage, and container security fundamentals.

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agents in production, including tool use and function calling, the Model Context Protocol (MCP server and client implementation), prompt and context engineering, and evaluation of agent behavior.

  • Working knowledge of software supply chain security: SBOMs, image signing and attestation, vulnerability management, minimal and hardened base images, and secure CI/CD.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems: identity providers (Okta, Entra ID, LDAP/Active Directory), federated identity protocols (OIDC, SAML), secrets managers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Ability to scope and deliver complex work in ambiguous, fast-moving customer environments, making sound trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality.

  • Excellent communication skills with engineers, security and platform teams, and executive stakeholders, with a low-ego, collaborative approach and the ability to lead through influence rather than authority.

  • Proven track record of technical mentorship and of raising the bar for the engineers around you.

  • High agency and comfort operating autonomously in distributed, remote-first teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Travel to customer sites to build in person with customer teams, estimated at up to 50%.

Bonus

jobs.title: Senior Integrated Campaign Manager
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

 

Senior Integrated Campaign Manager

DeepL · Reporting to the Director of Performance Marketing and Campaigns

About the Role

DeepL's translation portfolio is trusted by well over 20,000 companies and hundreds of millions of professionals worldwide. Rather than organizing our go-to-market by product line, we run a single integrated campaign that speaks to the different people who drive adoption of that portfolio organized by persona, not by feature set. As Integrated Campaigns Manager, you will own the persona motion targeting Global Operators, the department heads in Marketing, HR, and Learning & Development who are responsible for how their organizations communicate globally. Other campaign owners run the parallel motions for personas like Product, Engineering, and Developers; your job is to build the strategy, narrative, and channel mix for the Global Operators audience specifically.

This role sits at the intersection of integrated marketing, demand generation, and account-based marketing. You will start from how Marketing, HR, and L&D leaders think, communicate, and buy, then shape DeepL's capabilities into narratives and programs that speak directly to their priorities. You will orchestrate multi-channel campaigns from concept to launch, and partner closely with Product Marketing, SDR, and Field Marketing to bring targeted, personalized programs to personas in our highest-value accounts.. You will report to the Director of Performance Marketing and Campaigns and work cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content, Creative, Regional Marketing, and RevOps..

What You'll Own

Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Translate DeepL's translation capabilities into compelling, pipeline-driving campaigns tailored to how functional leaders operate and buy, educating the market on the value of AI-powered translation for global business communication.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, Field, Performance, and SDR teams to develop go-to-market programs and nurture streams aligned with persona priorities and regional needs.

  • Collaborate with Content, Creative, and Regional Marketing teams to produce and localize campaign assets.

  • Maintain a global campaign calendar and asset library, ensuring brand consistency, messaging alignment, and timely deployment across all touchpoints, and coordinate with owners of other persona tracks (e.g., Product/Eng/Dev) so the portfolio campaign reads as one coherent motion.

Account-Based Marketing (ABM)

  • Collaborate with the rest of the team to design and execute ABM programs, building tailored campaign strategies, messaging, and content for prioritized accounts and account tiers.

  • Partner with Performance Marketing and RevOps to feed account engagement, pipeline influence, and conversion data back into ABM targeting and strategy decisions.

  • Continuously refine account segmentation and messaging based on engagement signals, win/loss insights, and sales feedback.

.

Measurement & Optimization

  • Drive measurable impact on awareness, adoption, and pipeline; setting and tracking KPIs such as lead quality, conversion rates, account engagement, and ROI.

  • Collaborate with Performance Marketers to initiate data-driven optimization and A/B testing across campaign channels and ABM plays to continuously improve performance.

  • Leverage insights and competitive intelligence to inform campaign strategy, refine positioning, and identify new opportunities in the AI translation market.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Foster cross-functional collaboration and campaign excellence, sharing learnings, best practices, and post-mortem analyses to continually improve performance and scalability.

  • Serve as the campaigns subject matter expert, representing campaign and ABM performance in relevant leadership and planning forums.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing, campaign management, demand generation, or ABM roles.

  • Proven track record of managing complex, multi-channel campaigns from strategy through execution.

  • Understanding account-based marketing programs, including account tiering, personalized content, and multi-touch orchestration alongside Sales.

  • Demonstrated success driving pipeline generation and revenue growth through integrated and account-based campaigns.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and meet deadlines.

  • Data-driven decision-making and proficiency in campaign analytics, attribution, and performance optimization.

  • Excellent communication skills for cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management, particularly with Sales and SDR teams.

  • AI literacy, including familiarity with GenAI tools for campaign planning, content creation, and execution.

  • Preferred: previous experience in high-growth SaaS companies (Series B–IPO stage).

  • Preferred: experience with ABM platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks) in addition to core marketing tech.

Technical Requirements - nice to have

  • Marketing Automation: HubSpot

  • CRM: Salesforce (or equivalent)

  • ABM Platform: 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks, or similar (preferred)

  • Project Management: Asana, Jira, or similar tools

  • Content Management: Contentful or comparable CMS/DAM platforms

About DeepL

DeepL is Germany's best-known AI company. People and their communication challenges are at the heart of everything we do. Founded by researchers in 2017, we have developed the world's most accurate AI translation and writing technology — serving well over 20,000 companies and hundreds of millions of professionals worldwide.

Accessible across the web, browser extensions, desktop and mobile apps, and an API, DeepL supports a best-in-class communication experience across 31+ languages.

 
 

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

 

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.title: Lead Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Why loveholidays?

We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.

 

The difference you’ll make

You’ll lead the Applied AI team within the wider AI Centre of Excellence, setting technical direction and managing the engineers who build, administer and improve the AI-enabled systems and SaaS platforms that support our customers and colleagues. You’ll work closely with business verticals, engineering, security and senior stakeholders to turn business priorities into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes.

You’ll combine people management with hands-on technical leadership across applied and agentic AI workflows, SaaS services, integrations and data pipelines. You’ll guide architecture and delivery, develop the team’s capabilities and own relationships with third-party SaaS suppliers, ensuring our platforms are reliable, secure and deliver value for money.

The team sits within Business IT & AI Operations. You’ll provide the direction, governance and operational ownership that help loveholidays scale intelligent automation and well-run business systems safely and effectively, balancing new opportunities with service quality, cost and long-term maintainability.

Your day-to-day:

  • Lead and line-manage Applied AI engineers, setting clear goals, providing regular feedback and coaching, supporting career development and managing performance. Help recruit and onboard new team members as the team grows.

  • Set the team’s technical direction and delivery roadmap with business and technology stakeholders, prioritising work, allocating capacity and managing dependencies to deliver measurable business outcomes.

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership for applied and agentic AI workflows, integrations and automation pipelines, guiding architecture, reviewing designs and code, and contributing to complex or high-impact engineering work.

  • Set standards for building, testing and evaluating tool-using agents with Google ADK or similar frameworks, including safe tool access, human oversight and production readiness.

  • Own operational performance across AI-enabled services and SaaS platforms, including service health, access, releases, usage and cost. Lead incident escalation and continuous improvement, with clear evaluation criteria and service measures.

  • Own account management for third-party SaaS suppliers, acting as the primary relationship owner and running regular service and roadmap reviews. Hold suppliers accountable for agreed service levels, resolve escalations and coordinate their delivery with internal priorities.

  • Manage the supplier and contract lifecycle with procurement, finance, legal and security, covering selection, onboarding, licensing, commercial negotiations, contractual obligations, renewals, notice dates and exit planning.   • SaaS Supplier & Account Management: Experience owning third-party supplier relationships, service reviews, escalations, licensing and renewals. Commercial judgement and the ability to work with procurement, finance, legal and security to improve service quality and value for money.

  • SaaS Platform Ownership: Experience leading the administration and lifecycle management of cloud-based business systems, including configuration, user access, environments, integrations and releases.

jobs.title: Sr Product Marketing Manager, Platform
jobs.description:
Product Marketing turns Chainalysis innovation into customer value. We position our intelligence as solutions customers can understand and consume through our platform, shape how we commercialize them, and give GTM the stories and strategic assets to win. Customers reach our intelligence through products, AI agents, workflows, APIs, data and expert services. This role owns what those add up to. Our segment leads make it specific to an industry; you make the case for Chainalysis as a whole, and build the programs that grow each customer over time.

As Senior Product Marketing Manager for Platform, you will own the positioning for the Chainalysis platform as a whole, then turn it into the lifecycle campaigns and programmes that drive adoption, usage and expansion across our customer base.

This is a horizontal role working across every segment. It suits a problem solver rather than a feature marketer: you start from what customers are trying to do and what gets in their way, then work back to what we offer. You are metrics-savvy. You know what moves the needle and which levers to pull to meet an objective. You will work closely with Product, Sales, Customer Outcomes, Marketing & Communications and GTM Solutions & Readiness, alongside the segment leads who go deep on their industries.

In this role, you'll:

Position the value

  • Define and evolve the Chainalysis story: what our intelligence enables, why we are meaningfully different, and why the whole is worth more than any one part.

  • Build the messaging that lets GTM teams tell that story consistently.

  • Own competitive positioning: frame the category and turn market moves into guidance deal teams can act on.

Build the programmes that grow it

  • Build the lifecycle campaigns that take customers deeper into the platform and scale them in partnership with demand generation, product and sales strategy: onboarding, activation, expansion and renewal, each with its own message and moment.

  • Spot the expansion patterns that hold across segments and turn them into cross-sell and upsell plays: the trigger, the message, the proof, and the asset a seller uses.

  • Explain our commercial model in the customer’s terms, so buyers can see how what they use connects to what they get.

  • Lead go-to-market planning for launches that span the portfolio, working with segment leads on the value proposition for each audience.

Win and learn in market

  • Produce the strategic content that moves these conversations forward: first-call decks, value maps, discovery frameworks, ROI stories, objection handling and sales plays.

  • Partner with Product, Product Marketing, GTM & Enablement teams to turn the strongest narratives into field tools sellers can find and use without asking.

  • Turn churn, win-loss, field feedback and competitive signal into sharper positioning, and measure what reflects business health rather than activity.

We're looking for candidate who have:

  • 8+ years in product, solutions, industry, or B2B enterprise technology marketing.

  • Experience building something from nothing: a new proposition, segment or business line where there was no playbook.

  • Positioning that changes how customers and sellers see a problem, and connects many capabilities into one value story.

  • Experience designing lifecycle campaigns or expansion programmes where you owned the messaging and mechanics.

  • Exceptional writing and editorial judgment. You can write crisp headlines, persuasive narratives, practical sales content, and executive-level messaging; you know the difference between jargon and precision.

  • A collaborative self-starter, comfortable driving ambiguous, multi-stakeholder work forward across Product, Sales, technical and revenue teams, and senior leaders.

Nice to have experience:

  • Experience with blockchain, digital assets, or crypto-native financial infrastructure.

  • Experience marketing AI-powered products, data platforms, intelligence products, cybersecurity, or risk and compliance technology.

  • Familiarity with consumption- or usage-based pricing and packaging.

You’ll thrive here if:

You enjoy connecting many products into one story more than marketing a single product in isolation. You build from first principles and create structure where none exists. You write with precision, build for repeatability rather than one-off requests, and care about the quality of what reaches customers and the field. You know when to go deep and when to simplify, and help raise the standard of the work around you.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I (New Grad)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Are you a recent or upcoming graduate ready to launch your career at the forefront of industrial IoT? Join us and help shape the future of connected operations. You will immediately dive into challenging, real-world projects with the freedom and responsibility of a full-time engineer. We believe in providing a greenfield opportunity for growth and a high degree of ownership from day one. You will build and innovate, making a tangible impact on our global customers. You'll also have access to the latest AI tools, with generous token allotments, giving you the leverage to ship more and learn faster.

At Samsara, New Grads can work on a wide range of high-impact engineering challenges across our connected operations platform. Depending on the team, a New Grad may help build the backend infrastructure that powers our IoT platform, scaling data ingestion and storage systems that support over 15,000 hardware assets and tens of thousands of customers around the world. They may also work across the full stack, creating intuitive user experiences that turn data from millions of devices into actionable insights, while partnering closely with product and design to rapidly iterate on features that deliver real customer value.

On the mobile side, a New Grad could help strengthen the infrastructure behind our React Native app, enabling feature teams to move quickly and build performant, maintainable products. For those focused on embedded software, projects may include building and maintaining software that runs directly on Samsara hardware, spanning areas like edge AI, multimedia frameworks, power management, and real-time data processing in demanding real-world environments. 

Throughout the interview process, we will dig into your past experience, what you are most interested in learning next, and where you would be the best fit across our engineering teams.

Our engineering teams use Golang for backend development, TypeScript and React for the web client, GraphQL for data access, and React Native for mobile development. Direct experience with this exact stack is not required, but experience with similar technologies is strongly encouraged. 

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will help keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and - most importantly - ensure workers return home safely.
  • You believe customers are more than a number. Our engineers are deeply invested in our customers and the daily problems they face. They visit customers in person to understand not just how Samsara helps them today, but where our products need to go next. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with success and product teams, and use metrics to ensure your work translates into real outcomes.
  • You're curious and self-driven. You challenge yourself outside of class - hackathons, side projects, tearing apart how something works just because you want to understand it. You move fast, embrace new technology, and treat learning as constant.
  • You're drawn to hard problems and own them end to end. You dig into complexity, research it thoroughly, and find the simplest solution that works - then see it through, holding yourself to a high standard along the way.
  • You're AI-forward. You've woven AI into how you work, whether that's accelerating debugging, drafting code, or exploring unfamiliar problem spaces faster. You're quick to experiment and always looking for smarter ways to build.
  • You're a collaborator. You work well independently and across cross-functional teams, and you're motivated by winning together, not just individually.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Current Senior pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field, with an expected graduation date in 2027.
  • This is a full-time, remote OR in-person hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in our London, UK office and 2 days working remotely.

Applications will close October 30th at 6:00pm (UK) 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. We turn complex challenges across merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, commercial systems, operations, risk, and compliance into reliable products and services that other teams can build on. Joining Run & Grow means working on high-impact engineering problems with a broad view of the business. You'll collaborate across disciplines and teams, shape the foundations behind important merchant journeys, and help create a more connected, scalable way for SumUp to run and grow.

  • Build capabilities supporting merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, operations, risk, and compliance.
  • Own technical work end to end, from discovery and system design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production follow-up.
  • Modernise existing services and improve reliability through observability, security, failure handling, and incident response.
  • Collaborate with Product, Data, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Sales, Marketing, and other engineering teams to turn complex requirements into practical solutions.
  • Review code and designs, make pragmatic technical trade-offs, share knowledge, and mentor engineers around you

  • Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
  • Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns

jobs.title: Stage Chef.fe de projet migration applicative en santé
jobs.description:
Dans le cadre de la migration de notre application desktop, nous recherchons un.e stagiaire pour piloter le suivi de l’adoption et accompagner nos clients tout au long de leur transition vers la nouvelle solution.

L’objectif sera de permettre au plus grand nombre de clients de migrer dans les meilleures conditions avant le transfert progressif du suivi à notre équipe Support, à l’issue du stage.

Ce stage combine gestion de projet, communication client, accompagnement au changement, analyse de données et compréhension des environnements informatiques hospitaliers.

Tes missions

Piloter la communication autour de la migration

Tu construiras et déploieras un plan de communication adapté aux différentes étapes de la migration :

  • Identification des clients à contacter et segmentation des populations ;

  • Préparation des messages de premier contact ;

  • Organisation des relances et suivi des réponses ;

  • Adaptation des communications selon le niveau d’avancement des clients ;

  • Gestion des objections, questions et éventuels points de blocage ;

  • Formalisation des bonnes pratiques et des argumentaires.

Prioriser les migrations

Tu contribueras à définir une stratégie de priorisation des clients en fonction de différents critères :

  • Taille et typologie des établissements ;

  • Niveau de maturité ou de préparation technique ;

  • Contraintes liées à l’environnement informatique ;

  • Niveau d’engagement et de réponse des interlocuteurs ;

  • Risques identifiés et complexité de l’accompagnement nécessaire.

L’objectif sera de concentrer les efforts sur les clients présentant le meilleur potentiel de progression ou nécessitant un accompagnement spécifique.

Mettre en place un tableau de suivi et des outils de reporting

Tu concevras et maintiendras un tableau de bord permettant de suivre l’avancement global de la migration, notamment :

  • Nombre de clients contactés ;

  • Taux de réponse et de relance ;

  • Clients migrés, en cours de migration ou non encore engagés ;

  • Principales raisons de blocage ;

  • Actions réalisées et prochaines étapes ;

  • Indicateurs d’adoption et d’utilisation.

Tu t’appuieras notamment sur Mixpanel et sur les outils internes disponibles afin de fiabiliser le suivi et de produire des reportings réguliers à destination des équipes concernées.

Accompagner les clients

Selon les besoins identifiés, tu pourras également participer directement à l’accompagnement des clients :

  • Réponse aux questions liées à la migration ;

  • Coordination avec les équipes techniques et Support ;

  • Aide à la préparation des étapes de migration ;

  • Suivi des situations nécessitant un accompagnement personnalisé ;

  • Remontée des irritants et des besoins récurrents ;

  • Contribution à l’amélioration continue du parcours de migration.

Préparer le transfert à l’équipe Support

Une partie importante du stage consistera à préparer la reprise du suivi par l’équipe Support :

  • Documentation du processus de migration ;

  • Centralisation de l’historique et du statut de chaque client ;

  • Formalisation des procédures et réponses types ;

  • Identification des cas particuliers et des risques résiduels ;

  • Transmission des outils, méthodes et indicateurs de pilotage.

Profil recherché

Tu es étudiant.e en école d’ingénieur ou en formation supérieure spécialisée en informatique, systèmes et réseaux, gestion de projet ou domaine équivalent.

Tu disposes idéalement de connaissances en :

  • Administration système et réseau ;

  • Environnements informatiques d’entreprise ;

  • Analyse et suivi de données ;

  • Gestion de projet ou conduite du changement ;

  • Outils de reporting et d’analyse produit, notamment Mixpanel.

Une première compréhension des systèmes d’information hospitaliers serait un véritable plus.

Nous recherchons surtout une personne :

  • Structurée et organisée ;

  • À l’aise dans les échanges avec des interlocuteurs variés ;

  • Capable de gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle ;

  • Curieuse et autonome ;

  • Dotée d’un bon esprit d’analyse ;

  • À l’aise pour formaliser, synthétiser et suivre des plans d’action ;

  • Orientée résultats et satisfaction client.

Ce que tu apprendras

Ce stage te permettra de développer une expérience concrète sur :

  • Le pilotage d’un projet de migration à grande échelle ;

  • La communication et l’accompagnement de clients professionnels ;

  • La conduite du changement dans un environnement exigeant ;

  • L’analyse de données produit et l’utilisation de Mixpanel ;

  • La construction d’indicateurs de suivi ;

  • La coordination entre équipes Produit, Technique, Customer Success et Support ;

  • Les enjeux liés aux systèmes d’information hospitaliers.

Informations pratiques

  • Type de contrat : stage de 6 mois ;

  • Démarrage : dès que possible ;

  • Localisation : Place de clichy, Paris 8e ;

  • Équipe de rattachement : Customer Operations ;

  • Niveau d’études : école d’ingénieur ou formation équivalente ;
