jobs.title: Global Service Specialist - Semiconductor Equipment (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Description

Our quantum sensing technology is already operating in customer environments across United States, Asia and Europe. As our installed base grows and we move from first deployments to repeat orders, ensuring the reliability and performance of every system becomes increasingly important.

As our Global Service Specialist, based at our Munich HQ, you’ll be part of a rapid-deployment team that resolves complex and escalated technical issues across our worldwide installed base. You’ll step in where regional service teams and partners need deeper expertise, and support installations, commissioning, and repairs when situations require it.

You’ll work directly with leading semiconductor foundries, IDMs, and OSATs, ensuring our systems operate reliably and consistently meet their specifications. You’ll collaborate closely with our Engineering and Applications teams, combining technical problem-solving with a strong customer focus.

This is also an opportunity to help shape our global service function from an early stage, introducing the processes, tools, and standards that will support our growing international installed base.

 

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Act as the technical escalation point for regional service teams and distribution partners, resolving issues that require deeper system expertise.

  • Deploy rapidly to customer sites across Europe, the US, and Asia to resolve critical system issues and minimize downtime.

  • Support installation, commissioning, and qualification of our quantum sensing systems when required, working closely with our Munich-based engineering teams.

  • Perform advanced troubleshooting, calibration, and repairs across optical, laser, mechanical, electronic, and software subsystems.

  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues systematically, collaborating with Engineering and R&D when root causes go beyond service-level expertise.

  • Work closely with Field Application Engineers, who focus on measurement execution and customer applications, to ensure a seamless customer experience.

  • Support spare-parts planning and service logistics across the global installed base, ensuring critical parts are available for rapid response.

  • Document service activities, technical findings, and root causes, feeding recurring issues and improvement opportunities back into Product Development.

  • Build trusted relationships with customers and partners through clear technical communication and professional service in demanding semiconductor environments.

  • Help establish and continuously improve our global service processes, including escalation workflows, maintenance procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical documentation.

 

What is expected of you

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in field service, service support, or equipment engineering roles, ideally with semiconductor, optical, laser, inspection, or metrology equipment.

  • A proven track record of resolving escalated or complex system issues that first-line service could not solve.

  • Strong practical troubleshooting skills across complex electromechanical systems, ideally combining optics, lasers, precision mechanics, electronics, and control software.

  • Experience working in semiconductor fabs, cleanrooms, or similarly demanding technical environments, with an understanding of relevant safety and operating procedures.

  • Familiarity with laser safety and interlocked systems, or willingness to complete the necessary technical and safety qualifications.

  • Experience with spare-parts management, service documentation, and ERP or service ticketing systems is an advantage.

  • A structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges, especially under time pressure.

  • Strong communication skills and a customer-focused mindset, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and build trust with customers, partners, and internal teams.

  • Willingness to travel internationally on a frequent basis, often at short notice, to support customers and partners across the US, Europe, and Asia.

  • Fluency in English. Other languages (e.g. German, Mandarin, Korean) are a plus.

  • A degree in Engineering, Physics, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent technical training and relevant practical experience.

 

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

 

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

Project delivery & leadership

Embedded Staff Engineer - Help us build the Control System that the world can rely on. 

About Priva  

Your Future Ecosystem  

Located between Rotterdam and The Hague, in the heart of the world’s leading greenhouse region, lies Westland, home to Priva’s modern campus in De Lier. This innovative region has been the foundation of our family-owned company since the 1950s.  

 

What started as a hardware business has grown into a global leader in horticulture and building automation. Today, Priva develops advanced hardware, software, and digital services for climate control, energy efficiency, and water optimization. Our solutions support horticulture, indoor and city farming, as well as offices, hotels, hospitals, and retail environments worldwide.  

Our next ambition? Becoming a leading digital service provider with “Climate as a Service” solutions that help customers operate more sustainably.  

 

With over 600 colleagues, 16 international offices, and more than 400 installation partners, we deliver smart, sustainable solutions in over 100 countries. 

 

If you want your work to have impact on sustainability, food security, and the way cities grow, then this is where you belong.   
 

Why this role matters

At Priva, we are building the next generation of IoT-enabled building automation systems: cloud-connected, security-first, and designed for long-term reliability.

As a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (C++ / Linux), you will play a key role in shaping a scalable platform that combines embedded controllers, edge gateways, and cloud services. Your work ensures that buildings operate safely, efficiently, and reliably for 10-15 years with minimal maintenance.

This role goes beyond implementation. You will drive technical direction, influence software architecture, and support complex system design decisions across our platform.

Your role as Staff Engineer

You act as the bridge between software architecture and implementation, guiding teams in building a service-oriented, event-driven IoT platform consisting of 15+ services running on embedded devices.

You bring deep expertise in modern C++ (20+) and embedded Linux, and you help ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability across the system.

Your team

You will join our Alpha team, a group of highly experienced embedded software engineers and test engineers, working on cutting-edge building automation technology.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop embedded software in modern C++ (C++17 or later) on Linux 

  • Build scalable, modular, and configurable control components 

  • Implement deterministic and real-time control strategies 

  • Develop robust 24/7 runtime systems for real-world environments 

  • Create simulation environments and automated test frameworks 

  • Contribute to software architecture and design decisions 

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and quality gates 

  • Support application lifecycle management (ALM) 

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, cloud, QA) 


What you bring

  • 10+ years of experience in Embedded Software Engineering (C++ / Linux) 

  • Strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later) 

  • Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and SOLID principles 

  • Experience with multithreading, concurrency, and performance optimization 

  • Experience with distributed or service-oriented systems 

  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as MQTT, CAN, Serial 

  • Experience working in resource-constrained environments (real-time systems) 

  • Ability to review, challenge, and improve architectural decisions 

  • Strong debugging and system-level problem-solving skills 

  • Experience working in cross-functional and international teams 

Nice to have

  • Experience in IoT, building automation, or industrial systems 

  • Familiarity with Node-RED or control systems 

  • Experience with Yocto, Docker, or containerized environments 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices 

  • Experience with test strategies, automated testing, and system validation

 

What you get  
In numbers 

  • A competitive salary based on your experience; 

  • We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 

  • 8% holiday allowance; 

  • Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. 

 

For your own sustainability 

  • Be secured with our pension plan; 

  • Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

  • Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; 

  • Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football.

Our values 
Priva's mission is to create an optimal environment where people can work, grow and develop. We offer worldwide solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our ambition is to be known as the leading technology and service provider for sustainable urban deltas. We are proud that our solutions result in lower consumption of natural resources and contribute to some of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). 
 
Our culture is built around our core values; sustainable, innovation, make it happen and human. In our latest employment survey, our colleagues mainly described our culture as: open, ambitious, innovative, friendly, committed, informal, flexible and down to earth. We aim to be a dynamic, fast-paced, flat and informal organization, where our colleagues have the space to grow and develop. 
 
We believe that to be successful, it is important to include people with different perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. Every day, we continue to build our open culture with people who are driven to turn our vision into reality, regardless of who they love, where they are from, or what they believe in. We encourage and celebrate people to voice their opinions and be their authentic selves.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner / Corporate Recruiter
jobs.description:
Talent Acquisition Partner / Corporate Recruiter

Are you an experienced Corporate Recruiter who enjoys building strong relationships with hiring managers, finding the right talent and continuously improving the recruitment process? Join our HR team in De Lier and help us attract the people who will contribute to Priva’s future.

 

For this position, we are looking for a Dutch-speaking Talent Acquisition Partner who lives within commuting distance of our office in De Lier, the Netherlands. Excellent communication skills in both Dutch and English are required.

 

At Priva, our HR team is close-knit, energetic and ambitious. We believe recruitment is about more than filling vacancies. It is about understanding the business, challenging hiring managers when needed, creating an excellent candidate experience and finding people who truly fit our organization and ambitions.

As our new Corporate Recruiter, you will focus primarily on non-technical and commercial vacancies, including roles within account management, customer support, fulfillment and other business functions.

You will have the freedom to take ownership of your recruitment portfolio while working closely with hiring managers, HR colleagues and other stakeholders across the organization.

 

Climate for growth

Priva develops innovative solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our technology helps customers create smarter, healthier and more sustainable environments while reducing the use of valuable resources such as energy and water.

 

Our ambition is to contribute to a world where people can live and work in healthy, comfortable and sustainable environments. We call this creating a climate for growth. We encourage our employees to take ownership, think entrepreneurially and continuously look for ways to improve.

 

How you add value as a Corporate Recruiter

As a Corporate Recruiter, you are a strategic recruitment partner for your hiring managers and responsible for the full recruitment lifecycle of the vacancies within your portfolio. You understand what the business needs, translate those needs into attractive and realistic candidate profiles and know how to reach the right talent. At the same time, you keep a sharp eye on recruitment quality, candidate experience and an efficient hiring process.

You will:

·       Manage full-cycle recruitment for primarily non-technical and commercial positions;

·       Partner with hiring managers and leadership to define profiles, recruitment strategies and selection criteria;

·       Develop effective candidate sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter and AI-supported sourcing tools;

·       Proactively source and engage relevant talent in the market;

·       Help hiring managers create structured and effective interview and selection processes;

·       Ensure an excellent candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey;

·       Contribute to the further development of our employer branding and talent attraction activities;

·       Use recruitment insights and market knowledge to advise the business;

·       Identify opportunities to continuously improve our recruitment processes and ways of working.


Who you are

You are an experienced recruiter who combines strong people skills with a practical and business-oriented approach. You enjoy taking ownership, working independently and building trusted relationships with hiring managers.

You are proactive, curious and not afraid to challenge the business when you believe there is a better way to attract or select talent.

 

For this role, we are looking for someone who:

·       Has 3–5 years of experience in corporate recruitment or talent acquisition, preferably within a product, technology or international organization;

·       Has experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from intake and sourcing to selection and offer;

·       Is confident using LinkedIn Recruiter and proactive sourcing techniques;

·       Has experience working closely with hiring managers and other business stakeholders;

·       Understands the importance of candidate experience and employer branding;

·       Is independent, proactive and comfortable working in a dynamic environment;

·       Has a continuous improvement mindset and enjoys making recruitment processes better;

·       Communicates fluently in Dutch and English, both written and spoken;

·       Lives within reasonable commuting distance of De Lier, the Netherlands.


What you get   
In numbers 

·       A monthly salary between €3.600,00 - €5.100,00 based on your experience; 

·       We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 

·       8% holiday allowance; 

·       Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. 

 

For your own sustainability 

·       Be secured with our pension plan; 

·       Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

·       Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; 

·       Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football.

 

Ready to help us find the people behind our future?

If recruitment is more than filling vacancies to you, and you enjoy combining sourcing, stakeholder management and candidate experience, we would love to hear from you.

Apply and discover how you can help us create a climate for growth.

jobs.description:
Embedded Staff Engineer - Help us build the Control System that the world can rely on. 

About Priva  

Your Future Ecosystem  

Located between Rotterdam and The Hague, in the heart of the world’s leading greenhouse region, lies Westland, home to Priva’s modern campus in De Lier. This innovative region has been the foundation of our family-owned company since the 1950s.  

 

What started as a hardware business has grown into a global leader in horticulture and building automation. Today, Priva develops advanced hardware, software, and digital services for climate control, energy efficiency, and water optimization. Our solutions support horticulture, indoor and city farming, as well as offices, hotels, hospitals, and retail environments worldwide.  

Our next ambition? Becoming a leading digital service provider with “Climate as a Service” solutions that help customers operate more sustainably.  

 

With over 600 colleagues, 16 international offices, and more than 400 installation partners, we deliver smart, sustainable solutions in over 100 countries. 

 

If you want your work to have impact on sustainability, food security, and the way cities grow, then this is where you belong.     
 

Why this role matters

At Priva, we are building the next generation of IoT-enabled building automation systems: cloud-connected, security-first, and designed for long-term reliability. As a Embedded Staff Engineer (C++ / Linux), you will play a key role in shaping a scalable platform that combines embedded controllers, edge gateways, and cloud services. Your work ensures that buildings operate safely, efficiently, and reliably for 10-15 years with minimal maintenance. This role goes beyond implementation. You will drive technical direction, influence software architecture, and support complex system design decisions across our platform.

Your role as Staff Engineer

You act as the bridge between software architecture and implementation, guiding teams in building a service-oriented, event-driven IoT platform consisting of 15+ services running on embedded devices. You bring deep expertise in modern C++ (10+) and embedded Linux, and you help ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability across the system.

Your team

You will join our Prime team, a group of highly experienced embedded software engineers and test engineers, working on cutting-edge building automation technology.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop embedded software in modern C++ (C++17 or later) on Linux 

  • Build scalable, modular, and configurable control components 

  • Implement deterministic and real-time control strategies 

  • Develop robust 24/7 runtime systems for real-world environments 

  • Create simulation environments and automated test frameworks 

  • Lead technical design principles for embedded teams and align with our embedded architects on fit within overall architecture

  • Ensure quality solutions by leading the definition and adherence to technical design and coding guidelines

  • Promote craftmanship, quality gates and responsible AI practices across our embedded engineering community

  • Support application lifecycle management (ALM) 

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, cloud, QA) 


What you bring

  • 10+ years of experience in Embedded Software Engineering (C++ / Linux) 

  • Strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later) 

  • Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and SOLID principles 

  • Experience with multi threading, concurrency, and performance optimization 

  • Experience with distributed or service-oriented systems 

  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as MQTT, CAN, Serial 

  • Experience working in resource-constrained environments (real-time systems) 

  • Ability to review, challenge, and improve architectural decisions 

  • Strong debugging and system-level problem-solving skills 

  • Experience working in cross-functional and international teams

Nice to have

  • Experience in IoT, building automation, or industrial systems 

  • Familiarity with (industrial) control systems

  • Experience with Yocto, Docker, or containerized environments 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices 

  • Experience with test strategies, automated testing, and system validation

What you get   
In numbers 

  • A competitive salary based on your experience; 

  • We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 

  • 8% holiday allowance; 

  • Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. 

 

For your own sustainability 

  • Be secured with our pension plan; 

  • Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

  • Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; 

  • Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football.

Our values  
Priva's mission is to create an optimal environment where people can work, grow and develop. We offer worldwide solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our ambition is to be known as the leading technology and service provider for sustainable urban deltas. We are proud that our solutions result in lower consumption of natural resources and contribute to some of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).  
  
Our culture is built around our core values; sustainable, innovation, make it happen and human. In our latest employment survey, our colleagues mainly described our culture as: open, ambitious, innovative, friendly, committed, informal, flexible and down to earth. We aim to be a dynamic, fast-paced, flat and informal organization, where our colleagues have the space to grow and develop.  
  
We believe that to be successful, it is important to include people with different perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. Every day, we continue to build our open culture with people who are driven to turn our vision into reality, regardless of who they love, where they are from, or what they believe in. We encourage and celebrate people to voice their opinions and be their authentic selves.  
  
Apply

Wat ga je doen?

We zijn er trots op dat onze oplossingen resulteren in een lager verbruik van natuurlijke hulpbronnen, zoals energie en water. Om onze missie en ambitie waar te maken, zijn we op zoek naar toegewijde collega's. We zijn er trots op dat we met ruim 500 collega's, in 16 internationale vestigingen verdeeld over 12 landen samen met meer dan 400 internationale installatiepartners werken aan het leveren van onze duurzame oplossingen en diensten in meer dan 100 landen.


Wat zoeken we in jou?
We zoeken geen student die afwacht tot er een taak wordt gegeven. We zoeken iemand die ziet wat er moet gebeuren en het leuk vindt om het te regelen. Iemand die creatieve ideeen heeft en durft voorstellen te doen.

  • volgt een mbo-, hbo- of vergelijkbare opleiding richting Eventmanagement, Leisure & Events, Marketing, Communicatie of Hospitality;

  • zoekt een meewerkstage en geen afstudeerstage;

  • bent vanaf februari 2027 beschikbaar;

  • bent georganiseerd en houdt ervan om overzicht te creëren;

  • Beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • bent praktisch ingesteld en denkt graag in oplossingen;

  • vindt het leuk als geen dag precies hetzelfde is;

  • hebt interesse in zakelijke events, beurzen en marketing.

Ervaring met events is mooi meegenomen, maar enthousiasme, initiatief en organisatietalent vinden we belangrijker.

Wat krijg je ervoor terug?
Bij Priva krijg je geen stage waarin je vooral meekijkt. Je wordt onderdeel van het team en krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Je krijgt:

  • een afwisselende meewerkstage met echte verantwoordelijkheid;

  • directe begeleiding van een ervaren Event Manager;

  • de kans om meerdere events van dichtbij mee te maken;

  • ervaring met leveranciers, budgetten, planning en eventlogistiek;

  • een kijkje achter de schermen bij zakelijke events en internationale beurzen;

  • een stage waarin je kunt ontdekken waar jouw talenten liggen;

  • én natuurlijk een hele mooie eindstreep: GreenTech 2027.

Klaar om mee te organiseren?
Ben jij de student die liever regelt dan toekijkt? Die energie krijgt van een goede planning, blij wordt als alles op zijn plek valt en het leuk vindt om samen naar een groot event toe te werken?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer – Energy Optimization & Platform
jobs.description:
At Priva Energy, we build software systems that help customers manage and optimize energy in real-world environments, from greenhouses to buildings. You'll join one of our Energy Solutions teams (spanning Building Automation, Horticulture, and Energy Flexibility Trading), landing wherever the need is greatest at the time, and you'll also carry some responsibility for the cloud infrastructure and scalability that benefits teams beyond your own. 

You'll work at the intersection of three things: shipping features end-to-end in Priva Digital Services (touching both backend and, where needed, the front end), integrating optimization and forecasting logic into production services, and strengthening the cloud/DevOps foundation the whole department builds on. You don't need to be equally deep in all three, but you do need to be comfortable moving between them, and you should genuinely enjoy the connective, systems-level work of making things run reliably in production. 

 

Come Shape the Future of Sustainable Energy with Priva 

Priva Energy is working to become the leading global lifecycle partner for high-performing, sustainable buildings, horticultural operations, and energy distribution and management companies. Energy systems are transforming fast: grid congestion, dynamic pricing, decentralized production, and tightening sustainability regulation are reshaping what our customers need from us. Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions. 

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help turn that ambition into production reality: building the services, integrations, and cloud foundation that put our optimization and forecasting capabilities to work for customers every day. 

 

Your work will directly contribute to: 

  • Reducing and optimizing energy costs and emissions across Europe 

  • Enabling customers to participate in future energy flexibility and trading markets 

  • Optimizing multi-energy systems (heat, cold, electricity, storage, HVAC) 

  • Driving the transition toward autonomous, intelligent buildings and greenhouses 

  • Helping customers stay compliant with increasing regulatory pressure (e.g., CSRD) 

 

What You’ll Do 

Priva Digital Services & product engineering 

  • Design and build backend services that process data and execute optimization logic for products across Neo Heat, Neo Light, Neo Building, and Neo Smart 

  • Contribute to user-facing Priva Digital Services features end-to-end, including front-end work where it's the fastest path to shipping value 

  • Build and maintain APIs for internal and external integration 

Optimization & forecasting integration 

  • Implement and integrate optimization and forecasting logic into scalable, production-ready systems. You bring these models into production; you don't develop new optimization theory 

  • Work on data processing pipelines, scheduling logic, and system orchestration 

Cloud infrastructure & DevOps 

  • Own and improve cloud infrastructure (Azure) that supports scalability across Energy Solutions teams 

  • Strengthen CI/CD, monitoring, and deployment practices so systems are reliable, performant, and maintainable in real-world operation 

  • Collaborate with product, domain experts, and other engineers across teams to deliver end-to-end solutions 

  • Contribute to technical design decisions within your domain, and participate in the full software lifecycle: ideation → design → development → testing → deployment → monitoring 

 

What you will NOT do 

  • This is not a research or modelling role. You implement and integrate optimization and forecasting models rather than developing new theory 

  • You are not expected to be a dedicated front-end specialist or a dedicated DevOps specialist. The role spans these areas by design, so depth in every direction isn't the bar 


  • A bachelor's degree in an IT-related field 

  • Around 5 years of experience in a software engineering role, with demonstrated range across at least two of the following: backend/production systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end, or optimization integration. jobs.title: Security Architect
jobs.description:
Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.  

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  

To succeed in this role: 

  • You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". 

  • You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security" 

  • You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

  • You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

  • You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

  • You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

  • You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

  • You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

  • You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. 

In addition, you have the following technical expertise: 

  • Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security 

  • You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached 

  • ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level 

  • Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts 

  • Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries 

  • Zero trust architecture principles 

  • Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) 

  


The following competence is desired: 

  • OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) 

  • Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption 

  • Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

  • Container and Kubernetes security 

  • Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) 

  • Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. Experience implementing production projects with this stack is preferred, but not required if you are able to learn it quickly (based on your vast experience) 

What we offer you 

  

💶 Excellent remuneration — competitive and aligned with experience. 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 more at half price. 

🏦 Excellent pension contribution. 

🎓 Education budget of €1,000 per year. 

⏰ Flexible working hours. 

🍱 Onsite canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2). 

🏋️ Free onsite gym. 

🎉 Vibrant, open culture.

Brixio est un partenaire spécialiste de Cloudflare : intégration, services professionnels et services managés sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, de la sécurité applicative au SASE. L'équipe compte une trentaine d'ingénieurs répartis entre Paris, Dubaï et un centre de production à Casablanca. Les clients sont des grands comptes et des ETI en France, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les entités du groupe Equans.

La mission

L'ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE déploie Cloudflare One chez les clients français de Brixio, du cadrage technique à la mise en production. Il devient la référence opérationnelle Zero Trust de l'équipe France et prend en charge les projets SASE dès son arrivée, notamment le déploiement interne de Cloudflare One chez Brixio et l'accès distant sécurisé aux sites industriels du groupe Equans.

Responsabilités

  • Migrations : remplacer les VPN par du ZTNA et les proxies existants par Gateway, sans rupture de service pour les utilisateurs.

  • OT et industrie : sécuriser l'accès distant des prestataires et techniciens aux équipements industriels et techniques.
  • Sécurité des usages IA : appliquer les contrôles Cloudflare One aux usages de l'IA (détection du shadow AI, DLP sur les prompts, gouvernance des applications IA).
  • Livraison et passation : documentation (HLD, LLD, runbooks), recette avec le client, passation au support et au MSP de Casablanca.
  • Rigueur projet : travailler dans le périmètre signé, signaler au Delivery Manager toute demande hors périmètre avant de la traiter, et saisir son temps chaque semaine dans Brixio One.
  • Industrialisation : contribuer aux modèles de déploiement réutilisables (configurations types, Terraform, playbooks) pour accélérer les projets suivants.

Requirements

Profil indispensable

Le poste demande d'être opérationnel sur le SASE dès les premières semaines. Sans expérience SASE en production, la candidature ne sera pas retenue.

  • SASE en production : au moins 2 ans de déploiements Zero Trust / SASE chez des clients, sur Cloudflare One, Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA), Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cato Networks ou Fortinet SASE.
  • Expérience : 3 à 6 ans en sécurité réseau, intégration ou services professionnels.

  • Identité : SSO en SAML et OIDC, provisioning SCIM, Entra ID ou Okta.

Atouts

  • Expérience directe de Cloudflare One, ou certification Cloudflare (sinon, à obtenir dans les 90 jours suivant l'arrivée).

Le poste démarre sur le SASE mais ne s'y limite pas. Lead Designer
Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

As a Business Development Representative at Dust, you'll be instrumental in generating the qualified pipeline that fuels our rapid growth. This isn't a typical BDR role—you'll be pioneering AI-native sales development, using Dust's own platform daily to transform how prospecting and qualification work. You'll be joining at a pivotal moment as we scale from 60 to 180 people, working directly with technical leaders and founders at scale-ups and enterprise companies to connect their challenges to Dust's value. This role offers a front-row seat to category creation and a clear path to growth within our GTM organization.

What you'll do

Drive qualified pipeline generation

  • Identify and qualify new sales opportunities through targeted outreach to scale-ups and enterprise companies

  • Conduct cold calls and discovery conversations with technical leaders, founders, and decision-makers

  • Qualify leads by understanding their pain points and connecting business challenges to Dust's value proposition

Own the qualification and handoff process

  • Nurture prospects until they're sales-ready, providing detailed context to Account Executives and Solution Engineers

  • Ensure smooth handoffs that convert to high-quality SQLs with clear next steps

  • Track and manage your pipeline in close partnership with the GTM team

Experiment and optimize the sales motion

  • Collaborate with Marketing and GTM Engineers to test outbound campaigns and double down on what works

  • Define target personas and develop prospecting strategies to access key accounts

  • Use data to refine your approach and continuously improve conversion rates

Be a Dust power user

  • Use Dust agents daily to prospect, qualify, research accounts, and manage your workflow

  • Embody "Work AGI" by transforming your own processes and sharing what you learn with the team

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • 1-2 years of BDR/SDR or sales experience, or demonstrated hunger to break into tech sales with relevant transferable skills

  • Excellent communication skills in English to engage effectively with technical stakeholders; French is a strong plus for European market coverage

  • You know how to grab attention and adapt your message to different audiences

  • Strong coachability. You absorb feedback, iterate quickly, and continuously improve your approach

  • Performance-oriented mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets

Attitude

  • Team player who thrives in a collaborative, high-growth environment and actively shares knowledge

  • Self-aware and reflective. You own your results, learn from setbacks, and don't deflect responsibility

  • Strong ownership mentality. You take pride in your work and care about the impact you create

  • Ability to handle rejection with resilience and maintain a positive, curious attitude

  • Natural collaborator who makes the people around them better

Agency

  • Hustle mentality. You see opportunities and act on them without waiting to be told

  • Ownership over outcomes, not just tasks, you drive results end-to-end

  • Resourceful problem-solver who finds ways forward even with limited information

  • Track record of self-initiated projects or going beyond what was asked

  • Comfortable making decisions and moving fast in ambiguous, evolving situations

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Compensation: €45K – €65K

  • BDR Full Comp - FR • €45K – €65K

jobs.title: Staff Incubation Engineer-3
jobs.description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Staff Incubation Engineer

Snyk | Incubation Accelerator

Why this role?

Snyk’s Incubation Accelerator is seeking a Staff Incubation Engineer to join our innovative team, building transformative products from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity to operate with the agility of a startup, while leveraging Snyk’s extensive infrastructure, customer reach, and industry insights.

As a Staff Incubation Engineer, you will be at the forefront of technical innovation, tackling complex engineering challenges to develop a new product. This role demands full-stack development expertise, a strong grasp of system architecture for AI applications, and end-to-end ownership of the product lifecycle, from rapid prototyping to large-scale deployment. You will operate in a lean, agile environment, iterating rapidly on solutions to achieve product-market fit.

What You’ll Do

  • Full-Stack Product Development: Design, develop, and implement scalable, high-performance software solutions from scratch, covering both frontend and backend components.

  • System Architecture & Design: Architect flexible, scalable, and secure systems, ensuring robust, maintainable, and high-quality codebases.

  • Rapid Prototyping & Iteration: Build rapid prototypes to validate ideas, iterate on feedback, and pivot quickly to achieve the best product-market fit.

  • AI Agent Development: Design, develop, and deploy intelligent AI agents and autonomous systems, focusing on their integration into new product offerings.

  • Performance Optimization: Analyze and optimize system performance, ensuring high availability, low latency, and efficient resource utilization.

  • Cloud-Native Deployment: Design and deploy cloud-native applications leveraging modern infrastructure, including containerization and microservices architecture.

  • Agile Development & CI/CD: Operate within a lean, agile environment, utilizing continuous integration and delivery pipelines to accelerate development cycles.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineering teams to ensure cohesive product development and alignment with business goals.

  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Foster a culture of high ownership, creativity, and technical excellence.

What You Bring

  • Deep experience in AI/ML systems, including deploying intelligent agents using agentic or multi-agent architectures, with foresight for future needs and strategic alignment.

  • Strong proficiency in modern programming languages (e.g., Python, Golang, NodeJS) and frameworks, applying them to innovative products.

  • Experience with agile and CI/CD, with autonomy to streamline processes for efficient delivery in a fast-paced environment.

It’d Be Awesome If You Also…

  • Are genuinely excited by the prospect of working on early-stage products, engaging directly with customers to rapidly identify, prioritize, and iteratively solve problems to build truly beloved solutions.

  • Thrive in the face of complex, ambiguous technical challenges, consistently finding innovative solutions where others might see roadblocks, and embracing the iterative nature of startup development.

About Snyk

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Responsable Affaires réglementaires et qualité - Dispositifs médicaux H/F
jobs.description:
Assembleur et distributeur de dispositifs de perfusion et de nutrition entérale, IMM France (International Medical Mediation) est une PME française de référence sur son marché et située à Belfort (90).

Depuis 30 ans, IMM France est aux côtés des professionnels de santé et leur proposons des dispositifs médicaux répondant aux plus hauts standards d’exigence. Présent sur la prise en charge des patients à domicile et en milieu hospitalier, nous développons des dispositifs permettant de réaliser antibiothérapie, hydratation ou chimiothérapie à domicile, le patient conservant ainsi une qualité de vie optimale.

Afin de soutenir notre développement, nous recherchons notre nouveau Responsable Affaires Réglementaires et Qualité h/f.

 

Sous la responsabilité de la Dirigeante,

 

  • Vous êtes garant de la conformité réglementaire de nos dispositifs médicaux au regard des exigences des normes MDR 2017/745, LEA et de la transparence.

  • Vous êtes responsable du respect des normes, des exigences qualité et sécurité, ainsi que de la performance de nos produits.

  • En relation avec l’organisme certificateur, vous pilotez l’obtention de la norme ISO 13485. Vous établissez une veille réglementaire pour faire certifier nos produits dans divers pays européens.

  • Vous supervisez les actions liées à la matériovigilance et à la vigilance sanitaire.

  • Vous participez au pilotage d’études cliniques et animez des formations et webinaires à destination de nos clients.

  • Vous développez notre politique RSE et managez deux chargées de missions.


Vous disposez d’un Bac+5 en affaires réglementaires et/ou qualité, ainsi que d’une première expérience probante d’au moins 5 ans en laboratoire pharmaceutique ou autre société dans le D.M. Vous maîtrisez les normes MDR et ISO 13485.

Vous aspirez à intégrer une structure à taille humaine capable de vous impliquer dans un projet de développement ambitieux. Vous êtes force de proposition et appréciez le travail en équipe. Organisé, rigoureux et méthodique, vous savez évoluer dans un environnement réglementaire exigeant. Vous êtes disponible pour participer à des congrès ou autres événements. Une bonne pratique de l’anglais est indispensable.

Poste basé à Belfort (90).

jobs.title: Head of Sales – France & International
jobs.description:
À propos de Galénic

Fondée en 1978 par Pierre Fabre, Galénic est une Maison française de skincare scientifique qui associe excellence de la recherche, innovation et savoir-faire du luxe français.

Portée par son centre d'innovation scientifique à Toulouse et par l'ouverture de la Maison Galénic Paris, à quelques pas de la Place Vendôme, la marque entre dans une nouvelle phase de développement.

Notre ambition est de construire un modèle de distribution sélectif, international et omnicanal, conjuguant e-commerce, retail expérientiel, distributeurs premium et partenariats stratégiques.

Pour accompagner cette transformation, nous recrutons notre futur Head of Sales & Retail– Europe & International.

Votre mission

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction Générale, vous aurez la responsabilité de construire, piloter et accélérer le développement commercial de Galénic en Europe et sur ses marchés internationaux prioritaires.

Vous serez responsable de la performance commerciale, de la croissance du chiffre d'affaires et de la rentabilité de nos différents canaux de distribution.

Vous interviendrez à la fois sur la définition des stratégies commerciales, leur exécution opérationnelle et la structuration progressive des équipes.

Votre objectif : transformer l'ambition internationale de Galénic en un business durable, rentable et scalable.

Vos responsabilités

  1. Piloter la stratégie et la performance commerciale

  • Construire et déployer la stratégie commerciale à trois ans, en cohérence avec les ambitions de la marque.

  • Définir les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires, de rentabilité et de développement pour chaque canal.

  • Piloter les budgets commerciaux, business plans, forecasts et P&L par canal.

  • Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés : Net Sales, marge, productivité, conversion, sell-in et sell-out.

  • Identifier les opportunités de croissance et optimiser les investissements commerciaux.

2. Accélérer le développement du e-commerce DTC

  • Piloter la performance commerciale du e-commerce en collaboration avec les équipes Digital et Marketing.

  • Développer le chiffre d'affaires, le taux de conversion, le panier moyen et la fidélisation client.

  • Suivre la rentabilité du canal, les coûts d'acquisition et la contribution commerciale des investissements marketing.

  • Développer une approche commerciale fondée sur la connaissance client, les données et la performance.

3. Développer la performance de la Maison Galénic Paris

  • Accompagner le développement commercial de notre Maison, véritable flagship expérientiel de la marque.

  • Piloter les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires des soins et des ventes retail.

  • Optimiser les réservations, le taux d'occupation des cabines, la conversion post-soin et la productivité commerciale.

  • Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs, tout en préservant l'excellence de l'expérience client.

4. Construire et développer notre réseau de distribution international

  • Définir et déployer les plans de développement commercial sur les marchés prioritaires

  • Identifier, sélectionner et négocier avec les distributeurs et partenaires locaux.

  • Construire les business plans par marché : objectifs commerciaux, conditions de distribution, investissements, marges et rentabilité.

  • Piloter les relations avec les partenaires, leurs engagements commerciaux et leurs performances.

  • Accompagner les lancements et le développement progressif de nouveaux marchés.

5. Développer les partenariats stratégiques

  • Structurer un réseau sélectif de partenaires auprès des hôtels de luxe, palaces, spas, cliniques esthétiques, clubs privés et acteurs du luxe.

  • Identifier et développer les opportunités commerciales à forte valeur ajoutée.

  • Construire des modèles de partenariat rentables et pérennes.

  • Piloter la contribution de ces partenariats au développement commercial et à la visibilité de Galénic.

6. Construire et animer l'organisation commerciale

  • Structurer progressivement les équipes commerciales, en fonction du développement de l'activité.

  • Manager et accompagner les responsables opérationnels et commerciaux.

  • Développer une culture de performance, de responsabilité et d'excellence commerciale.

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Global & Regional Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain et les partenaires internationaux.

Profil recherché

  • 10 à 15 ans dans la beauté, dont une expérience significative en distribution internationale et une exposition réelle au e-commerce et au retail.

  • Expérience confirmée de direction commerciale ou de business development senior dans l'univers du skincare premium, de la beauté sélective ou du luxe.

  • Expérience significative du développement international, notamment à travers des réseaux de distributeurs.

  • Très bonne compréhension des enjeux du e-commerce DTC et de la distribution physique premium.

  • Expérience dans la construction et le pilotage de business plans, budgets et P&L.

  • Capacité démontrée à développer de nouveaux marchés, négocier des accords commerciaux et structurer des équipes.

  • Forte sensibilité à l'univers du luxe, à l'expérience client et à la valeur de marque.

  • Profil entrepreneurial, pragmatique, autonome et orienté résultats.

  • Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement international, interculturel et en transformation.

  • Anglais courant indispensable.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un rôle stratégique au cœur de la transformation et du développement international d'une Maison française de skincare scientifique.

  • L'opportunité de construire une organisation commerciale multicanale, avec une véritable responsabilité sur la croissance et la rentabilité.

  • Une collaboration directe avec la Direction Générale et la Direction Marketing

  • Un environnement entrepreneurial combinant héritage français, innovation scientifique et ambition internationale.

  • Une rémunération attractive.

Localisation : Paris, avec déplacements à l'international.

Rattachement : Direction Générale Galénic Europe.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Care Manager
jobs.description:
Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne.

Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds.

Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés.

Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund.

Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable.

  • Secteur : FinTech / Paiements en ligne

  • Localisation : Paris, France (Quartier du Sentier, 2e arrondissement)

  • Télétravail : Jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine (au choix)

L'équipe


Vous rejoignez l'équipe Customer Services composée de deux teams managées par Thibaut : Support Customer Care et Support L2. L'équipe Customer Care est composée actuellement de 4 personnes.

Le rôle


En tant que Senior Customer Care Manager, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la satisfaction et la fidélisation de nos clients. Avec un portefeuille composée des grandes comptes, vous serez chargé de fournir un support de haute qualité en répondant aux demandes clients, tout en prenant en charge la gestion opérationnelle pour nos clients.

Vous interviendrez également sur des projets transversaux stratégiques, en lien avec les autres équipes métiers, pour contribuer à l’amélioration continue de nos processus et services.

Vos missions principales


Gestion des demandes clients

  • Prendre en charge les tickets entrants en assurant des réponses précises, rapides et de haute qualité.

  • Répondre aux appels des clients sur une plage horaire définie, en assurant un traitement courtois, efficace et orienté solution.

  • Escalader les demandes complexes aux équipes métiers concernées (Payments, Compliance, Produit, Support L2).

  • Analyser les problématiques récurrentes pour identifier les axes d’amélioration et partager vos insights avec les équipes internes.

Gestion des clients prioritaires

  • Être le point de contact opérationnel pour certains de nos top clients, en coordonnant les réponses à leurs demandes et en assurant un traitement prioritaire.

  • Organiser et animer des revues opérationnelles à la demande des clients afin d’assurer un suivi rigoureux de leurs besoins et de leurs attentes.

Projets transversaux et expertise

  • Contribuer à des projets internes stratégiques, tels que la mise à jour de la documentation ou l’optimisation des processus.

  • Devenir référent(e) sur certains outils ou sujets spécifiques (Salesforce, Aircall/Ringover).

  • Accompagner et coacher les membres juniors de l’équipe pour partager vos connaissances et renforcer l’expertise globale de l’équipe.


Expérience et savoir-faire

  • Vous avez au moins 5 ans d’expérience en Customer Care / Support / Success

  • Vous avez une première expérience confirmée en fintech (paiements).

  • Vous avez développé(e) à travers vos expériences un relationnel fort qui vous permet de gérer des comptes complexes avec des stakeholders stratégiques.

Compétences techniques et relationnelles

  • Maîtrise de Salesforce, et d’un outil de téléphonie tel qu’Aircall ou Ringover (indispensable).

  • Une appétence pour les outils techniques et une capacité à analyser des données ou retours clients pour identifier des solutions.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, avec une approche orientée client.

  • La maîtrise de l’anglais et du français est indispensable. L’espagnol sera un gros plus.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Un environnement dynamique et stimulant où vos idées comptent.

  • La possibilité de travailler sur des projets d’envergure en collaboration avec des équipes transverses.

  • Un équilibre vie pro/vie perso avec un poste basé à Paris avec 2 jours de télétravail par semaine.

Autres avantages

  • Carte Swile 

  • RTT 

  • Mutuelle Alan 

  • Gymlib 

  • Remboursement Pass Navigo

Processus de recrutement

1. Introduction au processus de recrutement avec Sabina, Talent Acquisition Manager
2. Entretien technique avec Thibaut, manager de l'équipe
3. Test de motivation et personnalité (Assessfirst)

3. Echange avec un membre de notre équipe pour mieux comprendre le rôle, l’équipe et notre culture.

4. Entretien avec notre VP Customer Success


Lemonway s'engage à promouvoir la diversité, notamment en favorisant le mixité Femme/Homme et l'emploi de personne en situation de handicap.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Job title: Senior Data Engineer

Department: Data team

Reports to: Lead Data Engineer

Location: Paris, France

Contract: Permanent, local and full-time 

Starting date: ASAP 2026

PUR Description 

PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects. 

Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries. 

We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods. 

Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action. 

 

About the role 

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data processing solutions that power analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision making. You will play a key role in transforming raw project data into reliable, high-quality datasets through robust ETL processes, modern data architectures, and Python-based engineering practices. 

Working closely with business and technical stakeholders, you will ensure that data is accessible, trustworthy, and aligned with analytical requirements while contributing to the continuous improvement of our data platform and cloud-based ecosystem. 

 

Your responsibilities will be, but not limited to: 

 

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python.

  • Build and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and validation processes for large datasets.

  • Design and maintain data models supporting reporting, analytics, and business applications.

  • Implement and monitor data quality controls to ensure reliability and accuracy.

  • Manage and optimize workflows using orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of cloud-based data platforms (preferably Azure).

  • Support CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform).

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions.

  • Maintain technical documentation and promote data engineering best practices.


We are looking for someone with: 

  • 3-5 years of experience in Data Engineering, with strong Python skills and experience building production-grade ETL pipelines.

  • Strong SQL expertise and solid understanding of relational and analytical databases, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster) and implementing automated testing for data pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform is a strong plus).

  • Familiarity with AI tools (Claude is a plus).

  • Strong knowledge of Git and software engineering best practices.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, focus on data quality and reliability, and ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.

Recruitment process :

  1. Interview with the recruiter

  2. Interview with the manager and case study

  3. References check

At PUR, we strive to build inclusive teams and an equitable workplace where our employees feel respected, supported, and empowered. As a global company operating across six continents, we recognize that diversity in the workplace is essential to achieving our mission. 

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, race, gender, colour, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or any other aspect that makes them unique.

PUR is dedicated to providing an accessible environment for all candidates during the application process and for employees during their employment.  If you require accommodation or consideration throughout the interview process, let us know, and we will do our best to support you.

Over Eye

Eye Security maakt cybersecurity van topniveau, met een ingebouwde cyberverzekering, bereikbaar voor elk bedrijf in Europa, niet alleen voor de grote spelers. We zijn met ruim 190 collega's, met ons hoofdkantoor in Den Haag en een kantoor in Berlijn. Ons team komt uit de inlichtingenwereld, defensie, tech en consultancy.   • Je helpt onze recruiters kandidaten te vinden voor lastig in te vullen functies

De functie is nieuw en groeit mee met jou en met wat het team het hardst nodig heeft.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en redt je goed in het Engels

Over Eye Security

jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position Description

We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine.

Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving.

We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure.


What you will do

Data Architecture & Engineering

jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

  • Be familiar with selling to and negotiating with mid-market and enterprise customers, including deals above 20k USD

  • Be comfortable running discovery calls, demos and technical evaluations or POCs alongside a Solutions Engineer

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Make Your Mark as a Reliability Engineer at Storio group

About the role.

We are looking for a Reliability Engineer to join our production team and help optimize our machinery operations. In this role, you will analyze the lifecycle of our equipment, evaluate how we manage asset maintenance, and prevent potential downtime before it happens. You will work closely with operational teams to keep our production running safely and smoothly across our plant.

When failures do occur, you will advise the team on how to respond quickly and effectively. You will use data and engineering risk methodologies to develop preventive maintenance strategies, establish inspection criteria, and protect our business from performance losses. Your work directly impacts our operational efficiency and the continuous delivery of personalized products to our customers.



How you embrace curiosity daily.

  • Analyze statistical data, performance losses, and cost drivers to predict equipment failures and uncover improvement opportunities.

  • Facilitate root cause analysis using techniques like FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, and PHA for complex machinery issues.

  • Test new ideas and support machine trials to optimize process performance and material changes.

  • Review preventive maintenance programs and recommend technical updates to increase machinery availability.

  • Assess the technical feasibility of proposed changes from procurement and operational teams.

  • Explore innovative ways to streamline maintenance approaches while cutting overall operational costs.



How you make your mark.

  • Maximize equipment availability and reliability while lowering maintenance costs across the plant.

  • Develop effective maintenance strategies and clear standard operating procedures for autonomous maintenance.

  • Lead cross-functional improvement teams to solve persistent technical problems and boost site productivity.

  • Support capital investment projects to ensure new equipment meets strict maintainability standards and spare part requirements.

  • Conduct risk assessments to maintain full compliance with statutory inspection requirements, safety guidelines, and product quality standards.



What you bring to the team.

  • Strong experience as a reliability engineer or production specialist in a manufacturing environment.

  • Deep knowledge of reliability engineering techniques including FMEA, FTA, PHA, and criticality analysis.

  • Proven ability to facilitate root cause analysis and resolve complex technical equipment failures.

  • Practical background in developing preventive maintenance strategies, SOPs, and machine inspection criteria.

  • Hands-on experience supporting new machine installations, engineering trials, and capital projects.

  • Strong communication skills to guide production teams and collaborate on safety and quality standards.



What sets you apart.

  • Experience applying maintainability analysis within high-volume automated production settings.

  • Degree or formal qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, or Reliability Engineering.
