Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties
jobs.description:
Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties

Ben jij een ervaren installatietechnicus die klaar is voor een leidinggevende rol? Of geef je al leiding aan monteurs en wil je meer verantwoordelijkheid binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek? Dan hebben we bij Campus Installatietechniek in Barneveld een mooie uitdaging voor je! Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties combineer je jouw technische kennis met het aansturen en begeleiden van een team monteurs. Je zorgt dat werkzaamheden goed worden voorbereid, projecten volgens planning verlopen en jouw collega's hun werk optimaal kunnen uitvoeren. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen de monteurs, werkvoorbereiding, projectleiding en opdrachtgevers. Daarbij houd je overzicht, denk je mee over technische oplossingen en zorg je voor een prettige samenwerking.

Wat we je bieden

Bij Campus Installatietechniek krijg je de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, jouw team verder te ontwikkelen en mee te bouwen aan mooie installatieprojecten. Daar staat natuurlijk iets tegenover:

  • Een goed salaris dat past bij jouw kennis, ervaring en verantwoordelijkheden;

  • Een afwisselende functie voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Veel zelfstandigheid en vrijheid om jouw werkzaamheden te organiseren;

  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden;

  • Afwisselende projecten binnen de utiliteitsbouw en gebouwgebonden installatietechniek;

  • Opleidingen, cursussen en doorgroeimogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Moderne middelen en gereedschappen om je werk goed uit te voeren;

  • Een informele werksfeer met betrokken collega's en korte communicatielijnen;

  • De voordelen en ontwikkelmogelijkheden van de VDK Groep, gecombineerd met de persoonlijke sfeer van Campus.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en coördinatie van werkzaamheden binnen verschillende installatieprojecten. Je zorgt dat jouw team weet wat er moet gebeuren en dat projecten veilig, efficiënt en volgens afspraak worden uitgevoerd.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren van monteurs en technici;

  • Coördineren en verdelen van werkzaamheden binnen werktuigbouwkundige installatieprojecten;

  • Bewaken van de planning, voortgang, kwaliteit, veiligheid en kosten;

  • Afstemmen met projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders, opdrachtgevers en leveranciers;

  • Zorgen dat materialen, informatie en middelen tijdig beschikbaar zijn;

  • Meedenken over technische vraagstukken rondom klimaatinstallaties, verwarming en luchtbehandeling;

  • Signaleren van verbeterkansen en bijdragen aan efficiëntere werkprocessen;

  • Onderhouden van goede contacten met klanten en andere betrokken partijen.

Je staat dicht bij de techniek, maar houdt tegelijkertijd het overzicht over het grotere geheel. Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen de monteurs hun werk goed uitvoeren en worden projecten succesvol opgeleverd.


Wat neem je mee?

Je hebt een stevige technische basis binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek en vindt het leuk om collega's aan te sturen en verder te helpen. Je kunt goed organiseren, communiceert duidelijk en weet ook bij onverwachte situaties het overzicht te bewaren.

Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in het volgende:

  • Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding richting installatietechniek, werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar;

  • Enkele jaren werkervaring binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek, bijvoorbeeld als Eerste Monteur, Leidinggevend Monteur of Teamleider;

  • Kennis van gebouwgebonden installaties, zoals verwarmingsinstallaties, klimaatinstallaties en luchtbehandeling;

  • Leidinggevende kwaliteiten en het vermogen om collega's te motiveren;

  • Organisatorisch inzicht en een goed gevoel voor planning en kwaliteit;

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling;

  • Een proactieve houding en het vermogen om technische en organisatorische uitdagingen op te lossen.

Heb je ruime ervaring als Eerste Monteur of Leidinggevend Monteur en ben je toe aan een volgende stap? Ook dan komen we graag met je in contact!

Waar ga je het doen?

Campus Installatietechniek is een installatiebedrijf gevestigd in Barneveld. jobs.title: IT System Engineer (w/m/d), 80–100 %
jobs.description:
Kunden begleiten. Lösungen umsetzen. Verantwortung übernehmen.

Du willst die IT deiner Kunden nicht nur am Laufen halten, sondern verstehen, weiterentwickeln und verantworten? Bei Dukers betreust du eigene Kundenumgebungen von A bis Z – mit einem Team im Rücken, das sein Wissen teilt und bei kniffligen Fragen zusammensteht.

Über Dukers

Dukers ist ein Spin-off der Swisscom mit Sitz in St. Gallen. Wir planen, implementieren und betreiben die IT von Organisationen, die ihre Informatik in verlässliche Hände geben wollen.

Unsere Kunden erhalten eine Lösung aus einer Hand: Arbeitsplätze, Netzwerk, Server, Cloud-Dienste und Kommunikation werden von uns aufgebaut, laufend überwacht, aktuell gehalten und abgesichert. Die Verantwortung für den Betrieb liegt bei uns – mit festen Ansprechpersonen, die die Umgebung ihrer Kunden kennen.

Besondere Tiefe haben wir in Cloud-Infrastrukturen und UCC, gestützt auf starke Partnerschaften mit Swisscom und Microsoft. Unser Team besteht aus Spezialisten mit langjähriger Erfahrung – mit den Standards eines grossen Anbieters und der Verbindlichkeit eines Partners, der seine Kunden persönlich kennt.

Deine Rolle

Du bist die technische Ansprechperson für deine Kunden. Du kennst ihre Umgebungen, betreibst sie zuverlässig und setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um – von der Konfiguration über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur Dokumentation. Bei Migrationen und grösseren Projekten arbeitest du mit unseren Spezialisten für Netzwerk, Security und Cloud zusammen.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und entscheidest im Alltag selbst. Bei anspruchsvollen Fragen steht das Team hinter dir.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du betreust die IT-Umgebungen deiner Kunden, kennst ihre Anforderungen und bist ihre verlässliche technische Ansprechperson.

  • Du administrierst Microsoft-365-Tenants: Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, Exchange Online.

  • Du betreibst Clients, Netzwerke und Serversysteme, analysierst Störungen und behebst ihre Ursachen nachhaltig.

  • Du setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um und arbeitest bei Migrationen und Projekten mit.

  • Du erkennst, wo eine Umgebung sicherer oder stabiler werden kann, und bringst konkrete Vorschläge ein.

  • Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit sauber, damit jede Umgebung für das ganze Team nachvollziehbar bleibt.

Womit du arbeitest

  • Microsoft 365 und Cloud: Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Exchange Online, Azure

  • Virtualisierung: VMware Cloud Director, Hyper-V, Proxmox

  • Netzwerk: Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco, HPE Aruba

  • Security: Fortinet, Versa, Cisco

  • Rechenzentrum: Eigene Infrastruktur in einem der sichersten und nachhaltigsten Rechenzentren der Schweiz, auf der wir unsere Lösungen und die unserer Kunden betreiben

  • Betrieb: Backup, Monitoring und Ticketing mit Tools, die wir selbst entwickeln und weiterentwickeln

Netzwerk und Security betreiben wir als Managed Services – als Value Added Reseller der Swisscom für unsere gemeinsamen Kunden. Wer hier Tiefe aufbauen will, findet bei uns das Umfeld dafür.

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, beispielsweise als Informatiker/in EFZ, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen – idealerweise mit Entra ID, Intune und Defender

  • Solide Netzwerkkenntnisse: IP-Adressierung, VLANs, DNS und DHCP sind dir vertraut, Routing und Firewall-Regelwerke kein Fremdwort

  • Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Lernbereitschaft und Interesse, dein Wissen im Team einzubringen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Führerausweis Kategorie B

Idealerweise hast du bereits Kundenumgebungen eigenständig betreut. Stehst du noch am Anfang deiner Laufbahn, bringst aber die fachlichen Grundlagen und den Willen mit, dich einzuarbeiten, möchten wir dich ebenfalls kennenlernen. Deine Aufgaben und deine Verantwortung wachsen mit deinem Können – das Onboarding ist darauf ausgelegt.

Dein Arbeitsort und deine Einsätze

Dein Arbeitsalltag verbindet Einsätze bei Kunden in der Ostschweiz und im Raum Zürich mit Arbeit und Austausch in unserem Büro in der Stadt St. Gallen. Wir suchen dich in St. Gallen und Umgebung.

Das Büro liegt verkehrsgünstig: Die Autobahnein- und -ausfahrt Kreuzbleiche ist drei Minuten entfernt, Winkeln fünf. Die Bushaltestelle Schönenwegen liegt eine Minute vor der Tür. Parkplätze sind kostenlos. Dazu kommen ein eigener kleiner Park, ein Balkon direkt am Büro mit Grill – und der Blick auf die Geissli nebenan.

Was dich bei Dukers erwartet

  • Einarbeitung, die den Namen verdient: Du startest mit einem intensiven Training und arbeitest in den ersten Wochen im Tandem mit einer erfahrenen Kollegin oder einem erfahrenen Kollegen, bis du deine Umgebungen selbst verantwortest.

  • Fünf Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr: Bezahlt und für Zertifizierungen, Kurse oder Herstellertrainings nutzbar – wir fördern deine fachliche Entwicklung aktiv.

  • Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Dukers wächst, und wer diesen Erfolg mit erarbeitet, soll daran teilhaben. Deshalb beteiligen wir unser Team jedes Jahr am Unternehmenserfolg – zusätzlich zum Lohn.

  • Fünf Wochen Ferien, bei Bedarf mehr: Bis zu zwei zusätzliche Ferienwochen pro Jahr kannst du unkompliziert dazukaufen.

  • Arbeit, die zu deinem Leben passt: Familie, Weiterbildung, Sport oder ein Projekt, das Zeit braucht: Wir richten die Anstellung nach deiner Lebenssituation aus – mit einem Pensum von 80 % oder 100 %, Gleitzeit und Remote Work nach Absprache. Und wenn sich dein Leben verändert, verändern wir das Modell mit.

  • E-Firmenfahrzeug mit Privatnutzung: Ohne Zusatzkosten für dich, inklusive Ladepauschale. Und wenn du zu Hause laden willst, beteiligen wir uns an deiner eigenen Ladestation.

  • Geschäftshandy mit Mobilabo: Gehört zur Ausstattung.

Bei uns entscheidest du mit. Wer eine Umgebung betreut, kennt sie am besten – also liegt die Entscheidung dort, wo das Wissen ist. Siehst du eine bessere Lösung, bringst du sie ein, und wir setzen sie gemeinsam um.

Lernen wir uns kennen

Stellenantritt: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung. Und wenn du vor deiner Entscheidung einen Tag mit dem Team verbringen möchtest – gerne.

Deine Ansprechpersonen:

  • Livia Julia Tanner, Leitung Personal, nimmt deine Bewerbung entgegen und beantwortet Fragen zur Stelle und zu den Anstellungsbedingungen.

  • Aaron Herceg, Gründer und Governance Manager, leitet das Engineering-Team, mit dem du arbeitest, und beantwortet deine technischen Fragen.

Schreib uns an ----- mit Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätzen dazu, warum diese Stelle zu dir passt.

Dukers GmbH | St. Gallen

jobs.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. About the role:

Skydio builds the world’s most advanced autonomous drones used across inspection, public safety, defense, cinematography, and more. Your research won’t languish in a paper: it will fly, shaping how pilots and operators complete real missions in complex environments. Develop and deploy reinforcement learning (and adjacent policy-learning methods) that make Skydio aircraft plan, navigate, and control themselves more intelligently, safely, reliably, and efficiently across our ecosystem: handheld apps, ground control, cloud autonomy services, and fleet workflows.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Navigation & avoidance in the wild: Train policies that adapt online to cluttered 3D scenes (forests, bridges, urban canyons), complementing our stack for robust obstacle avoidance and dynamic goal-seeking.

  • RL-augmented planning: Fuse learned cost shaping / value functions with trajectory optimization for smooth, agile flight with tight safety envelopes and mission constraints.

  • Sim to Real at scale: Build scalable datasets and training loops with Isaac Lab, domain randomization, residual learning, and safety filters; validate on real drones weekly.

  • Human-in-the-loop shared control: Learn assistive policies that blend pilot intent, autonomy priors, and uncertainty-aware behaviors for intuitive control handoffs.

  • Fleet & multi-agent: Explore decentralized coordination for coverage, pursuit, and collaborative mapping with minimal comms.

What makes this internship different:

  • Real hardware cadence: Prototype in sim, then flight test on production-ready aircraft and edge compute. Your work is meant to make a difference in the real world, not just in simulation.

  • Safety-first learning: We pair RL with formal constraints, estimation of uncertainty, and conservative action filters for dependable deployment in human environments.

  • Cross-disciplinary mentorship: Collaborate with perception, mapping, controls, and product teams to close the loop from research to field ops.

What makes you a strong fit:

  • PhD student in Robotics, Machine Learning, Controls, or related field.

  • Strong fundamentals in RL, control theory, and motion planning; comfort with safety/robustness concepts.

  • Proficient in Python (PyTorch/JAX/Ray RLlib) and at least one of C++ or CUDA.

  • Hands-on experience with robotics simulation (Isaac Lab/MuJoCo/PyBullet) and sim2real techniques.

  • Experience training/deploying policies for navigation, manipulation, or locomotion on real robots or autonomous vehicles.

  • Publications (CoRL, ICRA, IROS, RSS, NeurIPS).

  • Experience with onboard inference optimization (TensorRT, quantization, sparsity).

  • Familiarity with modern policy learning beyond vanilla RL: diffusion policies, IL/BC, offline RL, model-based RL.

jobs.title: Head of Operations (Zürich, 100%)
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Head of Operations


⏰ Start date: ASAP

📍Zürich, Switzerland (on-site, remote not possible)

🦾 Full-time (100%)

Loki Robotics’ mission is to make physical services an abundant commodity for everyone through robotics and physical AI. We build, deploy and operate expert robots with unique capabilities to automate commercial facility services at scale. We believe emergent capabilities in physical AI are unlocked by taking a straight shot to useful, performant robots deployed in the real world. We’re a tight team that takes initiative, operates with agency, and genuinely cares about doing outstanding work.

Your role

Every robot we produce has to be prepared, shipped, deployed, operated, serviced and improved in the field. As Head of Operations, you own that end to end. You are the execution engine that customers and the rest of Loki rely on to make deployments happen, and you build the operations organization that keeps getting better at it: more automated, more productized and spread across more roles and geographies as we scale.

What you will be doing

  • Own deployment implementation: site assessments, customer kick-offs, onsite supervision, staff training, performance assessment and all customer communication along the way

  • Run logistics for every deployment: fulfillment, shipping, import/export, compliance and coordination with the customer’s receiving side

  • Build and run the operations organization: SOPs, scheduling, allocating operator bandwidth across deployments, testing and internal data collection, among others

  • Work with our testing engineers on release, performance and quality assurance testing: reporting procedures, schedules and the bandwidth to execute them

  • Relay what customers and field operations tell you back to product, GTM and R&D

  • Find operations bottlenecks and remove them, whether through a new process, a new hire, a change in structure or by killing a process entirely. Many ops tasks exist because a feature is missing or because that is how it has always been done. Your job is to delete, automate or productize them

  • Hire, onboard and lead the operations team: define roles, onboarding, incentives, internal assessments and the KPIs that steer our operations organization

  • Train partner operators and distributors in deployment operations as we expand

What you should have

  • 5+ years in operations, field deployment, implementation or a comparable role combining management and execution-heavy tasks. You have managed teams for a meaningful part of that experience

  • You have built an operations function at an early-stage company from the ground up, without a support structure already in place for you to consume

  • You have deployed physical products at customer sites: hardware, robotics, automation or industrial equipment. Robotics or facility services is a strong plus

  • You operate across both horizons at once: what has to happen in the next 12 hours and what the org needs to look like in 3 months. You know at any moment what the top priority is and what to delegate

  • You are hands-on. An undefined process, a missing checklist or one overworked colleague is enough for you to act, fixing it for tomorrow and making sure it does not come back

  • You are the best manager in the room. You set clear goals, put people where their strengths accelerate the team and get along with people from all walks of life.

  • You are detail-oriented and think from first principles, and you can turn that into clear, robust processes that others can just follow

  • You take action on a goal without waiting for direction, and ask for help when you need it without letting that block you

  • Excellent communication in English

What we offer

  • Ownership of Loki’s deployment, internal operations and field ops end-to-end

  • The opportunity to build and lead the operations org as we scale across geographies

  • Close partnership with the founders/leadership team

  • Flat hierarchy, quick decision making and real responsibility in executing Loki’s global expansion

  • Be at the forefront of changing how physical services are delivered

jobs.title: Account Manager - EMEA
jobs.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling believes in putting our customers at the center of everything we do. We strive to provide an exceptional experience for our customers and our users from the first touchpoint, through our implementations, and once they are live. We take pride in our world-class renewal rates, and Account Management is an essential part of this equation. To keep up with our rapidly expanding growth, we have a team of seasoned Account Managers with experience in Life Sciences, who can help grow the organization, develop our processes, and drive execution.

Our Account Manager team works alongside our Professional Services, Product, Sales and technical teams to help our most strategic customers enhance the value of their Benchling investments. Account Managers will engage regularly and strategize directly with our customers to ensure long term value. Alongside the client, they will develop strategies and tactics to understand the health of the client, own renewal negotiations and execution and drive expansion of success packages. Through regular engagements with the clients, Account Managers will identify clients who can benefit from a product or technical subject matter expert related to areas of improvement, and direct them to the approapriate team to drive progress on customer initiatives.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and maintain productive relationships with key stakeholders across Scientific and IT functional areas including customer champions and economic buyers

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
jobs.description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.

  • $15.00–$17.00 per hour, plus performance incentives

Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their cards for everyday life. How to Apply

jobs.title: Content Reviewer United States - English-speaking
jobs.description:
TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit.

 

A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US

In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform.

By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself.

Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies.

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

 

Qualification path

Qualification Process

No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process.

 

Basic Requirements

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years

• Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States

• Active use of Gmail and social media platforms

• Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content

• Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection

• Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher)

• Access to a personal computer

 

Assessment

You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish (ES)
jobs.description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

The hourly earnings for this role are 18 EUR per hour, payment is based on completed tasks.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

jobs.description:
Are you a talented Senior Designer looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

What we offer:

  • The rate depends on your seniority level, skills and experience. We've already paid out over $11M to our engineers & designers.
  • No more hunting for clients or negotiating rates — let us handle the business side of things so you can focus on what you do best.
  • We'll manually find the best project for you according to your skills and preferences.
  • Choose a schedule that works best for you. It’s possible to communicate async or minimally overlap within team working hours.
  • We respect your seniority so you can expect no micromanagement or screen trackers.
  • Communicate directly with the clients. Most of them have technical backgrounds. Sounds good, yeah?
  • We will support you from the time you submit the application throughout all cooperation stages.
  • Most of our projects involve working in a fast-paced startup environment. We hope you like it as much as we do.
  • Through our community, we will connect you with the best developers & designers from more than 75 countries.

We have different positions for Designers — please check the details below.

Requirements for the Senior UI & UX Designer:

  • 5+ years of experience in UI & UX Design
  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Figma & 5+ years with Prototyping/Product design, OR 5+ years of commercial experience with Figma & 3+ years with Prototyping/Product design
  • Experience with Adobe is required
  • Experience in Product design is a must

Requirements for the Senior Graphic Designer:

  • 5+ years of experience in Graphic Design
  • 5+ years of commercial experience with Adobe Creative Suite & Adobe Illustrator

Other requirements:

  • Strong design craft — as a Senior Designer, you're expected to build polished, production-ready work from scratch, with a solid grasp of design systems, component architecture, and how your decisions translate into real product or brand outcomes.
  • Clear and confident communication in English — advanced ability to discuss creative briefs, defend design decisions, and flag blockers early. Strong self-presentation is essential, particularly on client calls.
  • High ownership, zero hand-holding — you thrive working full-time remotely, manage your own time, and consistently hit deadlines without being chased.
  • Reliability — we need to trust you completely. If you commit to something, you deliver it. If something changes, you communicate early.
  • Fast ramp-up — you can absorb project context quickly, align with existing style guides or brand directions, and start producing valuable work within the first days, not weeks.

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

Reach out and we'll match you.
